Job Title: Research Integrity Screening Specialist

Location: Pune

Reports to: Team Lead, Research Integrity Screening

About Springer Nature

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are pioneers in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.

At Springer Nature, we recognise that great talent develops through many different paths. We encourage applications from individuals with strong transferable skills, provided they are supported by relevant experience that shows how those skills have been successfully applied in practice. Our hiring approach balances skills, experience, and potential to ensure each role is fulfilled with both short term effectiveness and long-term growth in mind.

About the Brand

Springer Nature’s Editorial Excellence team is a central expert team that supports Springer Nature with research integrity, journal editorial policy, and indexing. Within the Editorial Excellence team, the research integrity teams prevent and address concerns about research integrity and other breaches of publication ethics. The Editorial Excellence team ensures editorial and publishing best practice by producing training and ‘self-help guides’ for in-house staff and external editorial partners; contributes to system and workflow development; audits processes and technologies; provides clear and defensible action plans for complicated cases; leads journals editorial policy; and manages abstracting and indexing.

About the Role

The Research Integrity Screening Specialist plays a critical role in the pre-publication screening of submissions to resolve all identified integrity concerns. This role must blend a keen eye for detail, resourcefulness in fact-checking, and clear communication skills with our internal and external publication partners.

Roles Responsibilities

  • Analyze concerns in submissions flagged by Springer Nature’s research integrity technology solution, Screening Hub, applying critical scientific evaluation, manuscript assessment strategies, and strong decision quality to validate concerns, identify false positives, and ensure accurate outcomes to validate flags or remove false positives.

  • Conduct detailed manuscript assessments to evaluate flagged cases and decide, according to internal best practices and ensuring decision quality, which concerns can be remediated by the authors before reconsideration, which are false positives indicating that the submission is clear to proceed to next steps, and which are true positives to be actioned for withdrawal or rejection.

  • Review re-submissions where concerns have been remediated by authors to ensure compliance with requested changes.

  • Manage complexity inherent in this evaluation and decision process, and take an approach that is action-oriented.

  • Partner with internal team members and external service providers to assess and address integrity of issues that are flagged and remediation of submissions, demonstrating accountability.

  • Communicate concerns, where necessary and determined by protocols and SOPs, to Editors, Publishers, and authors for due consideration, according to relevant Springer Nature policies, COPE guidelines, and industry best practice.

  • Become an expert in the use of technologies and tools in order to provide insights into potential unethical behaviors and provide feedback regarding potential new features or improvements to publishing workflows & systems.

  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the evolving publication ethics landscape, identifying new types of issues, and contributing to policy development and improving workflows to address emergent needs.

  • Document case files, project plans, and statistics with detail and may use data analytics / quantitative skills to contribute insights to regular reporting.

  • With the assistance of the Team Lead, Research Integrity Screening, manage your workload to meet targets, rapidly reprioritizing as urgent issues arise.

  • Contribute, when requested by your manager, to other tasks and projects related to ensuring compliance with ethical policies/guidelines (e.g. policy and technology development, contributing to research projects, auditing journals).

  • Proactively contribute to meetings and commit to completing actions assigned to you, demonstrating accountability, ownership, and commitment to team objectives.

  • Drive your professional development by seeking training opportunities.

  • Be an advocate for continuous improvement, quality and efficiency. Foster a culture of openness, transparency and collaboration within the team and with our stakeholders.

Experience, skills and qualifications

Essential

  • Educated to Masters level in STEM or HSS

  • 2+ years’ of work experience in editorial or publishing.

  • Knowledge/experience of the academic publishing industry, and scholarly publication processes, systems and tools; and specifically in submission screening and/or evaluation.

  • Familiarity with publication ethics and research integrity issues, and a passion for quality control.

  • Ability to establish effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders of any background, seniority, or level of experience. A

  • A high level of computer literacy including knowledge of and experience with Office applications.

  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, analytical and time-management skills, with superior attention to detail.

  • Positive and proactive approach to problem-solving and task management.

  • Strong communication (written and oral) and English language skills.

Desirable

  • Ability to work well under pressure.

title: Software Developer
description:
AMETEK RTDS Technologies is a leading provider of real-time power simulation systems, catering to utilities, research institutions, and educational organizations. Our cutting-edge solutions enable the development and testing of the electric power grid and renewable energy applications. If you’re excited about driving innovation and enhancing the reliability of our energy infrastructure, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic and growing field!

Job Summary

The Software team at RTDS is responsible for the development of the RSCAD®FX software suite that customers across the globe use for designing, running, and analyzing their real-time simulation studies. The suite spans several technology stacks, so there is always something new to learn.

In this role you will focus on RSCADFX, the graphical application our customers use to build, run, and analyze simulations, and on the C backend that powers the simulation. You will work as part of a small, collaborative team on diverse work that ranges from GUI design and usability to performance-critical, modular backend code. It is a role for a strong, detail-oriented programmer who is equally comfortable in an application front end and in low-level systems code, and who takes ownership of what they build.

This is a challenging and rewarding role that reaches into the core of our technology, including the compiler and linker that turn models into real-time simulation code. We are looking for a developer who understands the compilation and linking process end to end and is very comfortable working with DLLs and native Windows applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain RSCAD FX, ensuring a responsive, intuitive user experience for customers running simulation studies.
  • Develop and maintain performance-critical backend software in C, including modular, dynamically loaded simulation components with clean, stable interfaces.
  • Contribute to the compiler and linker technology at the core of the platform, working with native code, DLLs, and the Windows environment.
  • Develop scripting, automation, and tooling in Python to support simulation workflows, testing, and build processes.
  • Write, modify, integrate, and test software to a high standard, while adhering to coding standards and development processes.
  • Profile, debug, and optimize compute-heavy code paths; analyze and enhance the performance and reliability of existing RTDS software.
  • Provide hands-on troubleshooting, debugging, and fixes during development and after release.
  • Prepare clear documentation on the operation and maintenance of software.
  • Work closely with other teams, especially Hardware and Support, to define functional and user-interface requirements and resolve customer issues.
  • Investigate, evaluate, and recommend technologies for new functionality and products.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • At least 5 years of full-time industry experience as a software developer.
  • Strong programming ability in Java, with hands-on experience building rich desktop GUI applications in JavaFX.
  • Solid working knowledge of C for backend and performance-sensitive code.
  • Experience with Python for scripting, automation, and tooling.
  • A solid understanding of the compilation and linking process, including how source code becomes executable code.
  • Strong familiarity with DLLs/shared libraries and developing native Windows applications.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and testing.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
  • Familiarity with development and debugging tools, including version control (Git), issue trackers, project-management tools, and CI/CD.
  • Exceptional attention to detail. This work rewards developers who chase down edge cases and leave no loose ends.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the patience to get things exactly right.
  • Technical curiosity, a drive to learn, and good interpersonal skills.

Deadline to apply: September 4, 2026

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive compensation and paid time off
  • Great benefits package that includes health, vision, dental, and fitness reimbursement program
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Group Retirement Savings with Company Match
  • Every day free parking, and free parking for Princess Auto Stadium events
  • Maternity and parental wage supplement and more!

Why work at RTDS Technologies?

This position is in Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada, a vibrant city known for its cultural diversity and friendly atmosphere. Enjoy festivals, museums, and a thriving culinary scene. With its four distinct seasons, Winnipeg offers a range of outdoor activities, including skiing and ice-skating in the winter, and hiking and boating in the summer.

To learn more about our company and our job opportunities, visit us at:

https://www.ametek.com/careers

To learn more about the business unit you’ll be joining, visit us at: https://www.rtds.com/

We thank all interested applicants; however, only those considered for interviews will be contacted. Disability accommodations available upon request.

Compensation

Currency: CAD

Salary Minimum: 105,000

Salary Maximum: 145,000

Incentive: No

Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.

AMETEK, Inc. is a leading global provider of industrial technology solutions serving a diverse set of attractive niche markets with annual sales over $7.5 billion.

AMETEK is committed to making a safer, sustainable, and more productive world a reality. We use differentiated technology solutions to solve our customers’ most complex challenges. We employ 22,000 colleagues, in 35 countries, that are grounded by our core values: Ethics and Integrity, Respect for the Individual, Inclusion, Teamwork, and Social Responsibility. title: Lead IBM i / Power Systems Engineer
description:
At Oshkosh, we build, serve and protect people and communities around the world by designing and manufacturing some of the toughest specialty trucks and access equipment. We employ over 18,000 team members all united by a common purpose. Our engineering and product innovation help keep soldiers and firefighters safe, is critical in building and keeping communities clean and helps people do their jobs every day.

SUMMARY

The Lead IBM i / Power Systems Engineer provides advanced technical leadership for our enterprise IBM Power and IBM i environment supporting mission-critical ERP and business applications. This role owns the health, performance, security, and evolution of the platform across IBM Power hardware, IBM i OS, HMC, VIOS, storage, and high-availability technologies.

As a senior technical resource, you will balance hands-on platform engineering and operational support with modernization, advancing automation, observability, security, and infrastructure best practices across the IBM i ecosystem.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex operational issues, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and security across IBM Power and IBM i environments.

  • Provide end-to-end engineering and administration of IBM Power infrastructure, including IBM i OS partitions, HMC, VIOS, PowerVM/LPARs, hardware, virtualization, storage, and related platform technologies.

  • Administer and optimize IBM i environments, including system configuration, patching/PTFs, upgrades, capacity planning, performance management, and lifecycle activities.

  • Configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize VIOS and Power virtualization technologies supporting enterprise workloads.

  • Support IBM Power hardware lifecycle management, firmware maintenance, capacity planning, and platform upgrades.

  • Design, test, maintain, and support high-availability and disaster recovery solutions to ensure ERP availability and business continuity.

  • Advance infrastructure automation using tools such as Ansible, CL scripting, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to streamline patching, compliance, and recurring operational activities.

  • Drive adoption of modern observability and AIOps practices to improve platform visibility, reduce alert noise, accelerate incident response, and proactively identify performance and reliability risks.

  • Strengthen IBM i platform security through system hardening, access controls, vulnerability remediation, compliance automation, and security best practices.

  • Partner across application, database, storage, network, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams to resolve complex issues and support platform modernization.

  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to engineers and other technology partners.

  • Evaluate emerging IBM Power and IBM i capabilities and recommend opportunities to improve platform reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Five (5) or more years of hands-on experience administering and supporting IBM i OS and IBM Power Systems in enterprise production environments.

  • Experience administering and troubleshooting IBM Power hardware, IBM i OS, HMC, LPARs/PowerVM, and VIOS.

  • Experience supporting high-availability and disaster recovery solutions within an IBM i environment.

  • Experience with IBM i system administration, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, patching/PTFs, upgrades, and capacity management.

  • Experience with CL or other scripting used to automate IBM i administration.

  • Strong understanding of ITIL processes, incident and change management, and stakeholder communication.

  • Strong technical leadership, communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and support planned after-hours maintenance, patching, and platform upgrades.

STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Ten (10) or more years of experience administering IBM i OS and IBM Power Systems.

  • Experience with MIMIX or comparable IBM i high-availability and disaster recovery technologies.

  • Experience with IBM DS-series or other enterprise storage and backup technologies supporting IBM Power and IBM i environments.

  • Experience with Ansible, Infrastructure-as-Code, or other configuration and infrastructure automation technologies.

  • Experience implementing observability or AIOps capabilities to improve monitoring, reduce alert noise, accelerate incident response, or provide predictive insights.

  • Experience with Fortra products such as Robot Alert, Robot Console, Compliance Monitor, Exit Point Manager, or comparable IBM i management and security tools.

  • Experience driving IBM i security, system hardening, vulnerability remediation, and automated compliance initiatives.

  • Experience supporting mission-critical ERP applications running on IBM i.

  • Experience contributing to platform modernization strategies or roadmaps for IBM i and IBM Power environments.

$92,600.00 - $154,400.00

Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. title: Winkelbeveiliger - TK Maxx Alexandrium
description:
TK Maxx

At TJX Europe, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritises your development. Whether you’re working in our Distribution Centers, Corporate Offices, or Retail Stores—TK Maxx & Homesense, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX team—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Van creaties die rechtstreeks vanaf de catwalk komen tot sieraden die uitblinken, we hebben een dagelijks veranderend assortiment. Dat is een hele andere manier van shoppen, het is schatzoeken. Een hele andere winkelervaring die gaat over het vreugdemomentje waarop je precies dat ene juweeltje vindt. Over de spannende verrassingen die het dagelijks leven een beetje leuker maken. Zo is het ook met werken bij TK Maxx. Ook onze werkomgeving verandert constant. Elke dag is er een nieuwe kans om iets nieuws te ontdekken. Discover Different.

Wat is TK Maxx?

TK Maxx is een warenhuis. Hier vind je alles wat je van een warenhuis mag verwachten: beautyproducten, kleding, schoenen, speelgoed en interieur styling. In ons warenhuis zorg jij ervoor dat onze klanten blij zijn. Voor onze winkelmanagement betekent dit dat elke dag anders is, omdat ook onze leveringen elke dag anders zijn.

Loss Prevention

Je werkt samen met het winkelmanagement om risico’s op de werkvloer te voorkomen. Je hebt een scherp oog voor verdachte situaties en handelingen en voor de veiligheid van een winkel. Denk hierbij aan mogelijke gevallen van overlast of onhandelbaar gedrag. Bij gevaarlijke of ongewenste situaties weet jij wat je te doen staat. Je ondersteunt klantenservice en je reageert op poortalarm. Je controleert diefstalbeveiligingen in dervingsgevoelige delen van de winkel.

Wat je bij ons gaat doen?

  • Je voert regelmatig controles en surveillances uit bij verschillende dervingsgevoelige artikelen.
  • Je communiceert over issues en/of diefstalindicaties (verwijderde beveiligingstags, lege verpakkingen etc.)
  • Je bent aanwezig in de buurt van de entree om vragen te beantwoorden
  • Je reageert snel en vriendelijk op poortalarm, dit gebeurt volgens onze richtlijnen
  • Indien een persoon een winkelontzegging heeft gehad, weiger jij de binnenkomst van deze persoon op een correcte manier
  • Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer: daarmee verklein je de kans op oneerlijk gedrag
  • Je assisteert bij een aanhouding van een winkeldief

Wat wij zoeken in jou?

  • Je bent in het bezit van een beveiligingsdiploma MBO niveau 2
  • Je wilt je verder ontwikkelen tot Loss Prevention Advisor
  • Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden
  • Flexibiliteit qua inzetbaarheid
  • Woonachtig in de buurt van Rotterdam

En waarom zou je voor ons kiezen?

Bij ons staat eerlijkheid, betrouwbaarheid en jezelf kunnen zijn op nummer één. Wij behandelen elkaar met respect en zullen jou altijd aanmoedigen om jezelf te zijn. Je mag jouw stem laten horen en werkt nauw samen in jouw team. Wij geven je de begeleiding en ondersteuning die jij nodig hebt. Ben je net zo ambitieus als wij? Dat is geweldig, want bij ons kun je doorgroeien! We ondersteunen jou maar al te graag bij iedere stap in jouw carrière bij TK Maxx.

Wat bieden wij jou?

We betalen het zelfde startsalaris voor iedere verkoopmedewerker, ongeacht jouw leeftijd (wij hanteren geen jeugdlonen)

We zorgen graag goed voor ons personeel en bieden een goed salaris, personeelskorting en een bijpassend contract. En zelfs meer:

  • Een uurloon excl. vakantiegeld en toeslagen. Dat geld komt er nog bovenop
  • Een jaarcontract van 38 uur, na 1 jaar wordt dit een vast dienstverband
  • 24 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime dienstverband)
  • Reiskostenvergoeding (als je meer dan 10 km van de winkel woont)
  • 8% vakantiegeld
  • Pensioenregeling
  • Personeelskorting EN we organiseren een aantal keer per jaar dubbel-discount-weekenden
  • Collectieve zorgverzekering
  • Een uitgebreid inwerkprogramma zodat je goed voorbereid bent
  • Concrete doorgroeimogelijkheden
  • Ontwikkelingsprogramma's
  • Een dynamische en kleurrijke werkomgeving
  • De primeur van al onze artikelen, zodat jij er elke ochtend als eerste bij kunt zijn

Bij ons is diversiteit geen trend, maar iets wat al meer dan 40 jaar het fundament is van onze organisatie. Vanzelfsprekend zijn sollicitaties van iedereen welkom. We maken geen onderscheid op basis van leeftijd, handicap, geslacht, geslachtsverandering, huwelijk en geregistreerd partnerschap, zwangerschap en moederschap, ras, religie of overtuiging en/of seksuele geaardheid.

As proud as we are of our past success, it’s our future that excites us most. We strive to provide opportunities for growth, recognition and a competitive salary and benefits package. Share our determination to think bolder and bigger, and be part of our future. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnerships, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and/or sexual orientation.

title: Appeals Resolution Analyst II / RN
company: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey
description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

This position is responsible for handling all Utilization Management medical appeal cases. Ensures that timeliness guidelines are met and appeal handled in compliance with regulatory requirements of various agencies including but not limited to NCQA,URAC and NJ/Federal regulations. Provides mentoring and clinical liaison support to appeals staff. Performs special projects as assigned by management

What You'll Do

  • Assesses patient's clinical need against established guidelines and standards to ensure that the level of care and length of stay of the patient are medically appropriate for inpatient stay.

  • Evaluates the necessity, appropriateness and efficiency of medical services and procedures by inpatient facilities.

  • Performs review of medical records and prepares medical records for review by Medical Director as appropriate.

  • Investigates and resolves complicated appeals, coordinating with legal department as necessary and handles appeals concerning pre existing conditions.

  • Investigates and resolves high priority cases involving DOBI and Executive inquiries.

  • Prepares and presents appeals to Appeals Committee in accordance with criteria including coordination with independent URO.

  • Conducts presentations of appeals process to internal customers and works with Delegate and Vendor Oversight to assist vendors in establishing procedures to ensure their appeals process complies with requirements.

  • Plans appropriate allocation of resources to provide quality patient care in the most cost effective manner.

  • Documents accurately and comprehensively based on the standards of practice and current organization policies.

  • Interacts and communicates with facilities, physicians and or members/families, either telephonically and or on site striving for continuity and efficiency as the member is managed along the continuum of care.

  • Evaluates care by problem solving, analyzing variances and participating in the quality improvement program to enhance member outcomes.

  • Facilitates the external review process with the IURO and IRO.

  • Provides 24/7 on call appeal support as scheduled.

  • Actively participates in enterprise meetings as management-s proxy as necessary.

  • Performs special projects as assigned by management.

  • Appeals Resolution RN’s are required to work a specified number of weekends and holidays to meet Regulatory and Accrediting body standards. Requirements may vary based on department’s business needs.

What You Bring

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.

  • Bachelor degree in health care management preferred or relevant experience in lieu of degree.

  • Requires 2 years clinical experience.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Leidos is seeking a Senior AI/Data Scientist to drive advanced AI development for a strategic Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA) contract, executed in direct partnership with the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA). You will work within a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, scientists, and software developers to physically and functionally characterize hardened facilities and Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) processes in order to create physics based models capable of supporting various simulations. This role supports customers operating in classified environments and requires close collaboration with subject matter experts, designers, engineers, analysts, and mission stakeholders to deliver innovative, operationally relevant data science and AI solutions. The Senior Data Scientist will lead complex analytics efforts across the full solution lifecycle—from problem definition and requirements development through design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operations and maintenance (O&M). The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, strong mission awareness, and the ability to communicate analytic insights to senior decision-makers.

.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a senior technical contributor and analytic lead on complex, high-impact national security programs
  • Partner with government customers and subject matter experts to define mission problems and analytic objectives
  • Translate ambiguous operational challenges into actionable data science requirements and solution designs
  • Design, develop, and deploy advanced analytics, statistical models, and machine learning solutions
  • Apply advanced data science techniques including exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, and algorithm development
    • Architect and deploy advanced machine learning models (e.g., Physics-Informed Neural Networks, Generative AI) that fuse engineering data with first-principles physics.
  • Translate and integrate structured and unstructured data from diverse sources across classified environments into physical and functional characteristic models for hardened facilities and WMD processes to support effects-based simulations.
  • Communicate analytic findings, insights, and recommendations to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. Bridge the gap between software engineers, intelligence analysts, and domain scientists to integrate data pipelines and transition proof-of-concepts into production.
  • Support deployment, monitoring, and ongoing operations and maintenance (O&M) of analytic solutions
  • Design, test, and deploy AI-driven software solutions to dramatically increase the efficiency, scale, and accuracy of engineering and scientific assessments.
  • Architect, deploy, and maintain advanced AI/ML pipeline components across disparate security enclaves, transitioning models from low-side development environments to the High Side.
  • Apply data science and AI algorithms to streamline overall program management, resource allocation, and mission execution metrics.
  • Mentor and guide junior data scientists and contribute to analytic standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks
  • Maintain awareness of emerging data science, AI, and big-data technologies relevant to national security missions

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship is required
  • Active TS/SCI w/ poly level clearance
  • Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field with 15+ years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree with 18+ years of relevant experience
  • Extensive experience applying data science and advanced analytics to complex, mission-focused problems
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and/or R, including advanced data science and machine learning libraries
  • Strong experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources
  • Proven experience developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining software applications and AI models within a JWICS (Joint Worldwide Intelligence Communications System) network environment.
  • Understanding of secure cross-domain solutions (CDS), data-transfer protocols, and the deployment of MLOps pipelines across air-gapped systems
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical efforts and influence analytic direction on large or complex programs
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including briefing senior leaders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in engineering data solutions within AWS (Amazon Web Services) GovCloud or Commercial Cloud Services (C2S).
  • Experience with Agile Scrum Development/Agile methodology.
  • Experience supporting intelligence community, Department of Defense, or other national security customers
  • Experience operating in classified computing environments
  • Expertise in one or more advanced domains such as machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, graph analytics, or predictive modeling
  • Experience with cloud-based or enterprise analytics platforms
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring technical staff or serving as a technical lead
  • Demonstrated experience providing instruction, instructional design, or curriculum development

This role also defines and facilitates communication between the business and its providers/vendors to deliver infrastructure software and OEM technology features according to plan and within budget and ensure licensing compliance.

The Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture will lead and develop NTT Data’s Cisco architecture strategy and roadmap with our Technology Solutions Global Multinational Clients (GMNC). Solutions are the underpinnings of our customers’ transformation. This role will have the opportunity to be on the bleeding edge of this transformation and to drive innovation with our emerging partners.

The Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture will be working on strategic areas of Cisco’s Networking, Data Center/Cloud, Cybersecurity and/or Workspace portfolio to drive growth in the business. This role will look to develop the technical relationship with their clients every single day.

This role will be a Trusted Advisor that is a solution advocate for their customers. They will lead the charge for helping to drive software value realization with clients leveraging the power of lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides expert multi-technology advice to internal clients, analyzing and providing strategies and solutions on all aspects of infrastructure software, hardware features and related technology components.

  • Architect end-to-end AI solutions: secure AI factories, data architectures, and automation frameworks.

  • Recommends, advises and executes on the best design for information technology architectures.

  • Leads the design and communicates high level structure to enable and guide the design and development of integrated solutions that meet current and future business needs.

  • Uses client business requirements to advise on the design, deployment and operation of infrastructures software.

  • Creates designs that provide holistic views, but also contain the details of the components and interconnections between components.

  • Involved with projects at the time of inception and is involved along with the project manager in the planning and governance of projects and the functional analysis (FA) of developing the initial requirements.

  • Researches and investigates emerging infrastructure technologies, particularly on software defined infrastructure features and the best practices associated with these trends.

  • Advises on the improvement of internal effectiveness by contributing to improving current methodologies, processes and tools.

  • Shares responsibility for win strategy with sales and leads the client discovery with relevant insights and articulate how our proven solution and services deliver tangible results.

  • Responsible for the Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) KPI and providing inputs on delivery, service offer design, of all aspects of Software Asset and License Management such as discovery, tracking, reporting, auditing, compliance, renewal, in line with the business objectives.

  • Works with Client facing teams to influence subscription license sales, provide educational inputs and act as SPOC for all licensing-related technical queries.

  • Manages and evaluates all regulations and legislation for licensing activities and ensure appropriate implementation and provide input into strategies.

  • Understands Software Asset Management and Software Licensing policies and standards to ensure legal, security, contractual, and regulatory compliance and advise accordingly for service offer development.

  • Provides support to the license renewals team and undertake a quality review of renewal request proposals prior to being issued to the relevant stakeholders.

  • Remains current on software licensing rules and regulations in order to provide advice on queries related to license usage to ensure no non-conformance when proposing appropriate licenses to client’s needs

  • Analyses client software purchases to identify suitable bundles for effective commercial license proposal.

  • Reviews the financial returns delivered by engagements to ensure the learning is captured as engagements deliver.

  • Leads transformation deals on the conversion of current software licenses into Enterprise Agreements, change to optimal license structure etc.

Knowledge and Attributes:

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain solid stakeholder relationships with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

  • Significant grasp of Cisco Smart accounts and Smart licensing.

  • Significant ability to share and communicate ideas clearly, both orally and in writing, to executive staff, business sponsors, and technical resources in clear concise language.

  • Excellent organization skills with ability to maintain focus on assigned tasks.

  • Significant understanding of a broad range of Hardware, Software, and Configuration operating models.

  • Significant knowledge of different licensing models – Perpetual, Right To Use, End-User, Subscription, Enterprise Agreements, etc.

  • Significant knowledge of relevant supply chain management methodologies and toolsets.

  • Significant ability to think strategically and tactically.

  • Ability to take data from multi sources and provide the reporting data for opportunity and Software Lifecycle Management (SLM).

  • Ability to construct solutions using their expertise to drive more of the solution functions to align with the offerings.

  • Significant knowledge on multi-technology infrastructure software, technology features and infrastructure solution design best practices in a variety of architecture domain including Networking, Data Centre, Collaboration and/or Security.

  • Significant knowledge of project management principles.

  • Significant knowledge of vendor roadmaps, new developments, and new product offerings.

  • Significant knowledge of key vendors licensing models, such as Cisco, Microsoft, VMWare and Palo Alto license structure, license tools and license commercial model.

  • Significant expertise in contract management, especially in contract negotiations.

  • Significant proficiency in financial concepts and practices as they relate to software license and contract management.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology or related field.

  • IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation qualification preferred.

  • TOGAF / COBIT or related certification preferred.

  • Certified Software related certification is desired.

  • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) certification and/or competitor certifications strongly desired

Required Experience:

  • Industry experience in sectors such as financial services, manufacturing, or healthcare.

  • Experience with AI solutions: secure AI factories, data architectures, and automation frameworks.

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Preferred Locations: Frisco, TX, Atlanta, GA - This is Hybrid role.

Technical Project Manager – Product Strategy & Technical Architecture,

We’re seeking a seasoned Technical Project Manager to lead the strategy, delivery, and evolution of high-impact transactional experiences across our consumer app. In this role, you will sit at the center of product vision and technical execution—owning the roadmap for browsing, redemption, checkout, payments, order management, partner integrations, and fulfillment while ensuring the underlying platform is scalable, secure, reliable, and built for growth.

This is an ideal opportunity for a technically fluent leader who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments and can translate business priorities into clear system-level direction. You’ll help shape architecture decisions, elevate engineering delivery, and drive exceptional customer experiences across critical transaction journeys.

Responsibilities

  • Own the product roadmap for transactional platform capabilities, including offers and redemption, marketplace and catalog, checkout and payments, order management, partner and merchant integrations, and fulfillment tracking.
  • Translate business and customer needs into actionable technical documentation, including PRDs, API contracts, acceptance criteria, process flows, and detailed requirements that enable clear engineering execution.
  • Partner closely with engineering leaders on technical architecture decisions, including build-versus-buy evaluations, service boundaries, event-driven design patterns, and third-party integration strategy.
  • Lead cross-functional squads across iOS, Android, backend engineering, QA, design, and data through discovery, prioritization, sprint planning, execution, and release.
  • Define, monitor, and improve critical platform KPIs such as API latency, transaction success rates, checkout conversion, uptime, SLA adherence, and error trends.
  • Drive the development and stewardship of the transactional data model and event taxonomy in collaboration with Data Engineering to support accurate analytics, reporting, auditing, and privacy compliance.
  • Manage external integrations with payment processors, loyalty or rewards providers, merchant APIs, and fulfillment partners, including API reviews, SLA alignment, and compliance considerations.
  • Balance feature delivery with platform health by identifying technical debt, scalability risks, and reliability concerns, especially during peak events such as promotions, flash sales, and holiday traffic.
  • Collaborate with Security and Compliance teams to embed PCI-DSS, tokenization, fraud prevention, and data privacy requirements into the product lifecycle.
  • Support incident response and operational readiness by participating in escalation processes, helping coordinate root cause analysis, and driving postmortem follow-through.
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, delivery risks, and architectural implications to senior stakeholders and executive leadership in clear business terms.
  • Champion best practices such as API-first design, observability, progressive rollouts, data contracts, performance budgets, and documentation as code.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of Product Management and/or Project Management experience, including at least 2 years in a technical, platform-facing, or systems-oriented role.
  • Demonstrated experience working directly with engineering teams on system design, architecture discussions, API definitions, and backend platform capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of transactional and e-commerce platform fundamentals, including catalog structures, checkout flows, payment processing, order orchestration, and fraud or risk controls.
  • Experience supporting native mobile app ecosystems and understanding how backend services power iOS and Android customer experiences.
  • Proven ability to produce high-quality technical requirements such as PRDs, API specifications, sequence flows, and acceptance criteria with minimal ambiguity.
  • Strong working knowledge of agile and scrum delivery practices, backlog management, sprint planning, and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Data fluency, including comfort working with SQL, dashboards, analytics requirements, event tracking, and performance measurement.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, design, legal, finance, data, and external partners.
  • Experience with payments, loyalty or rewards ecosystems, marketplaces, or high-volume consumer transaction platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with PCI-DSS, tokenized payments, fraud prevention controls, and privacy frameworks such as CCPA and GDPR preferred.
  • Experience in telecom, retail, fintech, or other high-transaction-volume environments preferred.
  • Technical degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent hands-on technical experience—preferred.
  • Familiarity with event streaming and modern platform tooling such as Kafka or Kinesis, cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP, observability tools, CI/CD workflows, and feature flagging solutions is a plus.

The base salary for this position is $92,000 – $145,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

title: Director, Wausau Window Brand
description:
Apogee Architectural Metals

Position Summary

The Wausau Window & Wall Systems Brand Director is responsible for the overall performance and growth of the brand, ensuring delivery of revenue, profitability, and customer satisfaction objectives. Partnering closely with the Vice President and executive team, this role drives a full-service, customer-centric business focused on delivering exceptional outcomes across the entire customer journey, from project award through execution, project completion, and long-term customer retention.

The Brand Director serves as the primary business leader responsible for aligning commercial and order and project execution functions to support profitable growth and operational excellence. This role requires extensive experience with large, complex façade projects and a deep understanding of architectural aluminum systems, project delivery processes, stakeholder management, risk mitigation, and customer experience.

The Brand Director provides direct leadership for Estimating, Client Services, Project Management, Drafting, and Order Management while collaborating closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and Manufacturing to ensure successful project execution and customer outcomes.

This role was created to lead the transformation of the Wausau Window & Wall business from a functionally managed organization to an integrated, customer-centric business with end-to-end accountability for customer experience, operational performance, and profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Business Leadership & Growth

  • Responsibility for P&L and the delivery of brand-level revenue, profitability, and growth targets.
    • Partner with the Vice President and executive leadership to develop and execute strategic plans that strengthen market position and drive profitable growth.
    • Align commercial and operational strategies to support customer success, growth with existing customers, and acquisition of new customers.
  • Establish and drive performance metrics related to customer satisfaction, project execution, operational efficiency, revenue, and profitability.
  • Identify and implement opportunities that improve business performance, customer value, and market position.

Customer & Standard Order/Project Delivery Leadership

  • Lead a customer-centric organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences from project award through project completion and post-project support.
  • Provide direct leadership for Estimating, Client Services, Project Management, Drafting, and Order Management.
  • Ensure successful execution of large, complex façade projects through effective project planning, risk management, resource allocation, customer communication, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Align commercial, operational, engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain functions to achieve business and customer objectives.
  • Serve as the senior executive contact for strategic customers and critical project escalations.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

  • Develop high-performing teams and future leaders through talent assessment, coaching, accountability, succession planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assess organizational capabilities and talent needs to ensure the business has the leadership, technical expertise, and execution capacity required to achieve strategic and operational objectives.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Transformation Leadership

  • Lead organizational transformation and cross-functional business improvement initiatives that enhance scalability, customer experience, operational effectiveness, and financial performance.
  • Build alignment across functions that have historically operated independently and establish an integrated operating model with clear ownership and accountability throughout the customer journey.
  • Simplify processes, reduce internal handoffs, and remove organizational barriers that inhibit customer outcomes and business performance.
  • Create clarity, alignment, and engagement while leading the organization through change.

Position Goals

  • Support delivery of annual revenue, profitability, and growth objectives for Wausau Window & Wall.
  • Improve customer satisfaction and retention throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strengthen coordination and execution across estimating, drafting, project management, order management, and client services functions.
  • Grow market share within targeted architectural and commercial construction segments.
  • Establish Wausau Window & Wall as the industry's preferred partner for complex façade and fenestration solutions.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Successfully transform the organization into an integrated, scalable, customer-centric business with end-to-end ownership of the customer experience.
  • Support Architectural Metals in building a service-driven organization capable of sustainable long-term growth.

Skills

  • Ability to prioritize multiple activities and meet established milestones and deadlines.
  • Strong strategic and business leadership capabilities.
  • Deep understanding of project delivery from order intake through project completion.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing revenue, profitability, and business performance.
  • Ability to build relationships and influence across customers, teams, and executive leadership.
  • Proven ability to align teams and drive accountability across multiple functions.
  • Excellent listening and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent Verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong mechanical orientation.
  • Excellent organizational skills.

Experience

  • 10+ years leading complex commercial construction, architectural systems, façade, glazing, or related manufacturing projects or businesses.
  • Experience leading multifunctional organizations.
  • Experience with P&L ownership.
  • Experience leading organizational change.
  • Experience managing customer-facing operations.
  • Knowledge and experience working in finishing and extrusion markets or related experience

title: Associate
description:
About this role

Company: BlackRock Financial Management, Inc.

Job Title: Associate

Location: 50 Hudson Yards, New York, NY 10001

Job Duties: Review existing Treasury Futures and Yield Curves model methodology and improve documentation for analytical models and processes for internal and external consumption. Scope, build, and maintain enhanced performance monitoring for most critical and widely used single security models and address issues when identified. Design, test, and deploy enhanced rates and derivatives financial models. Enhance BlackRock’s Aladdin platform with new security analytics, models and processes in response to market demands and industry events, and regulatory regime changes. Define processes for quality control and maintenance of analytics models to ensure best in class robustness and reliability of Aladdin’s analytics output. Utilize advanced analytics and communication skills to collaborate with BlackRock’s clients, portfolio and risk managers, and articulate clear financial modeling specifications. Understand production processes and liaise with partner teams to ensure smooth model deployments and maintenance. Resolve complex analytical enquiries with a keen understanding of analytics and models. Mentor and train junior analysts as they build expertise and gain exposure. Stay abreast on global finance, capital markets, geo-political scenarios, regulations and technology trends impacting BlackRock.

Qualifications: Master’s degree in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Financial Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field and one (1) year of experience as an Associate, Analyst or a related role. In the alternative, the employer will accept a Bachelor’s degree in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Financial Analytics, Mathematics, or a related field and three (3) years of experience as an Associate, Analyst or a related role. Must have one (1) year of experience with: Developing, deploying and using financial models including in Interest Rate & Derivatives: Short Rate Models, Volatility Surfaces, Yield Curves, and Black-Scholes Model (BSM); Advanced analytics including Futures and Options valuation, fixed income valuation techniques, and interest rate modeling; C++, XML, Linux, SQL, and scripting languages including Perl, Python, and LUA; Knowledge of Financial Markets including Fixed Income: Bonds, Options, Swaps and Swaptions; Experience monitoring risk exposures, identifying and explaining limit breaches, and tracing them to specific trades and products; Experience analyzing profit and loss drivers using Greeks and other risk sensitivities to provide clear attribution; Experience applying advanced market risk models, including Value-at-Risk (VaR) and conducting stress testing to assess portfolio resilience under extreme scenarios; and Experience with interpreting traders’ strategies, assess market dynamics, and project potential future movements to support informed decision-making.

To apply, please click “Apply” on this webpage.


For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$150,000.00 - USD$170,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.


Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

title: Sr Lead Solution Architect (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

As the Salesforce Solution Architect, you will own the end-to-end solution architecture for Salesforce Field Service, Service Cloud, mobile field operations, integrations, data, automation, and emerging AI/Agentforce capabilities. This role partners across Product, Field Operations, Architecture, Security, Engineering, and vendor teams to translate business outcomes into scalable, secure, supportable, and future-ready platform solutions that simplify field operations, improve technician productivity, and enable Lumen’s long-term digital transformation goals.

Only U.S. citizens or Permanent Residents/Green Card holders will be considered for this position.

Salesforce Field Service (FSL/SFS) experience is highly preferred

Location

This role is designated as a fully remote position within the United States.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own Salesforce solution architecture across Salesforce Field Service, Service Cloud, Field Service Mobile, dispatcher experiences, enterprise integrations, reporting data flows, automation, and AI-enabled field service capabilities.
  • Define target-state architecture, reference patterns, solution roadmaps, and phased delivery approaches that support field simplification, legacy platform modernization, and long-term platform scalability.
  • Lead discovery and solution design workshops with Product, Field Operations, Dispatch, Architecture, Security, Engineering, Data, and vendor partners to align business outcomes, KPIs, user journeys, and technical design decisions.
  • Translate complex field operations needs into durable Salesforce designs for Work Orders, Service Appointments, Service Resources, Service Territories, Work Types, Skills, Scheduling Policies, Dispatcher Console, Field Service Mobile, appointment lifecycle, job status lifecycle, and offline/mobile-first workflows.
  • Architect scalable integration patterns between Salesforce and enterprise platforms using MuleSoft, APIs, platform events, Kafka/event-driven patterns, secure data exchange, and resilient synchronization strategies.
  • Guide platform-first solutioning by evaluating out-of-the-box Salesforce capabilities before recommending configuration, automation, or custom development, ensuring solutions are maintainable, governed, and aligned with Salesforce best practices.
  • Design future-ready AI and automation capabilities, including Agentforce-powered technician assistance, work order summaries, guided troubleshooting, knowledge retrieval, next-best-action workflows, anomaly detection, and predictive operational insights.
  • Establish responsible AI design patterns, including grounding strategy, prompt and instruction design, guardrails, permission scope, privacy, auditability, monitoring, and alignment with enterprise AI governance.
  • Create architecture artifacts, solution blueprints, data and integration diagrams, decision records, non-functional requirements, security considerations, deployment patterns, and support transition materials.
  • Partner with Technical Architects and Lead Engineers to validate detailed designs, review implementation approach, manage technical debt, ensure platform limits are respected, and support high-quality delivery across Agile teams.
  • Drive architecture governance for scalability, performance, reliability, security, data quality, observability, supportability, CI/CD, release readiness, and operational resilience.
  • Assess impacts across legacy applications, upstream/downstream systems, reporting platforms, technician mobile workflows, customer notifications, and field operations processes to reduce risk during phased modernization.
  • Influence stakeholders through clear executive-ready communication of options, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, assumptions, and recommended paths forward.
  • Mentor architects, engineers, analysts, and delivery partners on Salesforce architecture, Field Service best practices, platform governance, and future-ready solution design.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience delivering enterprise technology solutions, including 6+ years of Salesforce experience and 3+ years in a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, or senior architecture leadership role.
  • Deep hands-on understanding of Salesforce Field Service and Service Cloud, including work management, scheduling, dispatch, technician mobility, service resources, territories, skills, work types, appointment lifecycle, and job status lifecycle.
  • Proven ability to define end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture for complex, integration-heavy, enterprise-scale programs with multiple stakeholder groups and phased delivery milestones.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, limits, data model design, security model, sharing, permissioning, automation, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, platform events, custom metadata, and release management practices.
  • Experience designing mobile-first and offline-capable Salesforce Field Service experiences for field technicians, dispatchers, supervisors, and back-office users.
  • Experience architecting integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, MuleSoft or equivalent middleware, event-driven architecture, Kafka/platform events, secure file/data exchange, retry/error handling, and operational monitoring patterns.
  • Ability to evaluate business requirements against Salesforce out-of-the-box capabilities and recommend configuration-first, scalable, supportable solutions before pursuing custom development.
  • Working knowledge of data architecture, reporting pipelines, operational analytics, data migration, master data alignment, and downstream reporting considerations such as GCP, Databricks, or equivalent platforms.
  • Practical understanding of Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder, Data Cloud/Data 360, knowledge retrieval, and AI-enabled service workflows.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect, System Architect, Field Service Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architect, Data Architect, or Agentforce Specialist are strongly preferred.
  • Experience in telecommunications, large-scale field operations, dispatch optimization, technician mobility, appointment management, customer notifications, or legacy field operations modernization.
  • Experience leading Salesforce Field Service transformation programs involving legacy system decommissioning, phased coexistence, integration modernization, data migration, reporting modernization, and operational change management.

title: HR Coordinator
description:

Are you an organized, service-oriented HR professional who enjoys creating positive employee experiences and keeping important processes moving? This role partners across Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, IT, and business leadership to ensure associates receive timely, thoughtful, and consistent support. A Day in the Life:

  • Lead the end-to-end onboarding experience, including preboarding communications, orientation, Form I-9 completion, workstation preparation, onboarding schedules, and coordination with HR, IT, and hiring managers.

  • Create and maintain HR templates, process documentation, standard operating procedures, and shared resources.

description:

WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

Job Description Summary:

Associate Director of Clinical Operations is responsible for driving standardized care conduct in assigned clinics across the practice in compliance with federal, state, and local standards as well as the policies and procedures of the organization. Partner with regional nurse leader(s) to ensure clinical staff adherence to policies and procedures. Mentors and leads teams to support nursing in achieving best practice performance for quality patient care, as well as employee engagement. Performs other duties and projects as assigned.

Position Qualifications/Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing required. Master’s degree in nursing, business or healthcare preferred

Certifications/Licenses:

  • Registered Nurse in Florida, OCN required, Valid state Driver’s License for travel to satellite offices and offsite meetings. Compliance with the company Driver Safety Operations and Motor Vehicle Records Check Policy is required.

Previous Experience:

title: Freelance Web Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Web Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality web designs for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in UI/web design, layout, and visual communication to transform briefs and concepts into clean, on-brand, and implementation-ready web designs. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in UI/web design, marketing pages, and digital visual communications.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Web Designer, your focus will be on marketing pages, landing experiences, and conversion-driven layouts. We need a core specialist dedicated to owning the look and feel of all web-based materials, ensuring they feel consistent, polished, and perfectly aligned with the broader brand ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-converting one-pagers, pitch-style landing pages, and simple marketing sites based on textual copy, outlines, or existing drafts.
  • Translate brand assets and social media visuals into responsive web layouts, structured components, and sections that can be easily implemented by developers or no-code tools. • Prepare and securely package production-ready files (organizing Figma frames, exporting assets, and detailing specs) for seamless handoff.
  • Ensure absolute visual consistency between interactive web pages, static PDFs, and social materials.
  • Enforce layout quality standards through systematic verification of responsiveness, proper spacing, clarity, and adherence to modern web trends prior to delivery.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in web design, UI design, digital marketing design, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Web Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or related creative/technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on landing pages, marketing websites, and product or startup one-pagers demonstrating clear hierarchy and strong typography. We are looking for specialists who are confident working from rough prompts, AI-generated drafts, or existing brand systems to convert them into structured, implementation-ready web designs. A user-centric, conversion-minded approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Web & UI Design: Deep proficiency in Figma for creating scalable, responsive web layouts, auto-layout components, and comprehensive design systems.
  • Conversion-Driven Layouts: Expertise in structuring high-converting, pitch-style landing pages with a strong eye for clarity, spacing, and modern design trends.
  • Developer Handoff: Solid understanding of how to prepare, spec, and package digital assets for efficient implementation via developers or no-code platforms (e.g., Webflow, Framer).
  • Cross-Platform Consistency: Ability to seamlessly translate core brand aesthetics across varying touchpoints, ensuring web pages match existing social materials and pitch decks.

Additional requirements

  • A structured, user-centric, and conversion-minded approach to design.
  • Strong eye for clarity, white space, and modern web layout trends.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver production-ready assets fast.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with web design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant web design cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
