title: Senior Software Developer
description:
Job Description

Posted Tuesday, July 7, 2026 at 10:00 AM

Wenco International Mining Systems ( www.wencomine.com ), a subsidiary of Hitachi Construction Machinery (HCM), provides industry leading, innovative technologies to customers in the mining and material movement sectors, enabling sustainable and safe operations.

Wenco has R&D offices located in Canada and Australia, and this specific role is based in Richmond, B.C. at Wenco's headquarters.

Focus: Hands-On Modernization, Technical Execution, Legacy Extraction

The Role

Wenco's Fleet Management System is a real-time, mission-critical application that has supported global mining operations for decades. We're building a new team to modernize it, and we want a Senior Software Developer at the core of it.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation: a strong base salary, profit sharing program, and RRSP matching.
  • Flexible working: choose between a hybrid or a fully remote arrangement, with fully remote roles attending key team events in person.
  • 9/80 schedule: opt in and take every second Friday off, for a three-day weekend every other week.

Why This Role

  • Rapid technical growth: Broad exposure across modern and legacy stacks, with the depth and ownership to level up your engineering skills fast.
  • Meaningful work: A system that mining operations depend on every day to operate with high efficiency.
  • Decisions that matter: Your contributions on defining system architecture, service boundaries, data models, and safe extraction will shape the platform for years.
  • Real ownership: The team owns this system end to end, and you'll own the increments and technical decisions you take on within it, not tickets handed down to you.
  • AI as a first-class tool: Lean on it for analysis, scaffolding, and the routine work, so your judgment goes where it counts.
  • A genuinely hard problem: A decades-old, real-time C++ system where the right way to carve it apart is rarely obvious.
  • Depth over churn: This is a multi-year build for engineers who want to go deep on a problem worth solving.

What You’ll Do

  • Understand the existing codebase: Read the existing C++ codebase well enough to make safe extraction and refactoring decisions, not risky rewrites.
  • Shape the architecture: Help define the high-level architecture: how functionality is carved out of the monolith, where service boundaries fall, and how the modern platform fits together.
  • Own the design: Design the software you build: architecture, data models, APIs, and how new services interoperate with the legacy system during the transition.
  • Write production code daily: Build new services on a modern stack: Kubernetes python microservices and React front ends, as functionality is extracted from the monolith.
  • Deliver end to end: Manage build, release, and deployment infrastructure & processes.
  • Build in observability: Ship instrumented code with logs, metrics, and traces, surfaced through the Grafana stack.
  • Own quality: Write tests across the pyramid (unit, integration, end-to-end, and UI automation) to keep extraction safe and regressions visible.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier: Apply AI tooling as a normal part of the work: codebase analysis, scaffolding, bridging legacy and modern systems, and low-risk refactors. AI is core to how this team operates.

Required Skills

A few things are essential. The rest of the stack is broad, and we don't expect anyone to be an expert in all of it. We're looking for strong depth in several of these areas and the ability to pick up the rest on the job.

  • Experience: 5+ years in production environments with complex, high-uptime systems.
  • C++: Comfort navigating and changing a large, mature codebase. This is where the hard extraction work lives, so some experience is required.
  • Languages: Experience with two or more of the core languages in use (C++, C#, Python, React).
  • Strong coding ability: You write clean, maintainable, well-tested code (with or without the assistance of AI).
  • Software design: You can reason about service boundaries, data models, and APIs, and make sound architectural trade-offs when carving functionality out of a monolith.
  • Ownership: You take ownership, get things done, and see the work through to a high standard.
  • Communication: Clear technical communication and documentation, working effectively with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Highly valued

We’d love depth in several of these, not all:

  • Modernization exposure: You've worked on extracting, migrating, or re-architecting legacy systems. You understand the traps, and you know what safe, incremental modernization actually looks like. This is exactly the work, so direct experience counts for a lot.
  • AI workflows: Hands-on skill with AI coding assistants and agentic workflows, driving them effectively and knowing where they help and where they don't.
  • Kubernetes: Deploying and operating services on Kubernetes; self-managed / on-prem (k3s) experience is a bonus.
  • Python: Building production services. This is the primary language for the new stack, so strength here is a real plus.
  • React: Building and maintaining front ends for the new applications.
  • C#: Part of our existing stack. Useful, but not critical.
  • CI/CD & infrastructure as code: Azure DevOps pipelines, Terraform, Ansible, and scripting in Bash or PowerShell.
  • Observability: The Grafana stack (Grafana, Loki, and related tooling) for metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards.
  • Test automation: Testing across unit, integration, end-to-end, and UI automation, with tools like pytest, Playwright, and Gherkin-based behaviour specs.
  • Domain experience: Fleet management, mining, or other industrial / real-time / device-comms systems.
  • Community contributions: Contributions to internal platforms or open source.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Eligible to work in Canada.
  • Occasional international travel (under 10%).

Base salary of $120,000 - $150,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Serves as a core faculty member within the Residency Program. Provides educational leadership across Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) accredited residency programs. Brings expertise in curriculum design, educational assessment, program evaluation, and research methodology to a complex, multi-program Graduate Medical Education (GME) environment. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads the design, development, and iterative refinement of curricula across residency programs using adult learning principles and competency-based medical education (CBME) frameworks. Collaborates with Program Directors to map education content to ACGME Milestones and Core Competencies, identifying gapes and redundancies. Develops and implements innovative instructional approaches, including simulation, case-based learning, flipped classroom models, and interprofessional education (IPE) activities. Maintains a current repository of curriculum maps, learning objectives, and educational resources for each program.

Provides expertise in educational measurement, including psychometric analysis of in-training examination data and milestone assessment validity.

Facilitates structured scholarly activity workshops, research methodology seminars, and writing skills sessions. Supports abstract preparation, manuscript development, and poster/oral presentation coaching for residents and faculty. Coordinates the GME Scholarly Activity Symposium and other forums for disseminating resident and faculty scholarship. Maintains awareness of funding opportunities (e.g., HRSA Teaching Health Center grants, foundation grants) and assists in grant application development.

Delivers faculty development sessions on topics such as direct observation, entrustable professional activities (EPAs), implicits bias in assessment, and coaching models. Supports the onboarding of new faculty and core teaching faculty regarding ACGME requirements and GME educational expectations.

Contributes to the Annual Institutional Review (AIR) and other institutional reporting activities. Particpates in GMEC meetings, PEC meetings, and relevant subcommittees as assigned. Assists in the development and evaluation of new residency and fellowship programs under consideration by the institution.

title: Data engineer (in opleiding)
description:
Je bent data analist en wil meer bouwen aan de achterkant: stabiele datapipelines, slimme modellen en betrouwbare platforms. In ons 1,5-jarig programma groei je stap voor stap naar de rol van volwaardig Data Engineer. Je werkt projectmatig bij een opdrachtgever, met ruimte om jouw route te kiezen. Blijf jezelf voor: we helpen je vooruit, op jouw manier. Na 1,5 jaar kun je na jouw opleiding in dienst treden bij de opdrachtgever!

Dit ga je doen
  • Je volgt een leerroute richting Data Engineer en past die direct toe in je opdracht.
  • Je ontwerpt en bouwt datapipelines (batch en/of realtime) en zet ETL-processen op, dit zodat je geen frustratie meer ervaart omdat je zelf bepaalt hoe duurzaam en robuust het gebouwd wordt. Dit doe je samen met collega's.
  • Je werkt mee aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van een dataplatform binnen een Microsoft Azure omgeving, waarbij je data uit verschillende bronnen samenbrengt en ontsluit. Dit doe je middels de Medaillion architectuur.
  • Je modelleert data en levert datasets op die klaar zijn voor rapportages en analyses.
  • Je borgt kwaliteit met testen, monitoring en heldere documentatie, bijvoorbeeld via Microsoft Purview.
  • Je stemt af met stakeholders; de inhoud verschilt per opdrachtgever en project
Je bent fit for the job als je...
  • je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring hebt als data analist, data scientist of BI developer.
  • je een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt behaald in Informatica, Data Science, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde, (Toegepaste) Wiskunde, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar.
  • je een stevige basis hebt in Power BI en Python en/of SQL
  • je ervaring hebt opgedaan met data modelleren binnen een cloud (Microsoft Azure) omgeving is een pré.
  • je enige ervaring hebt met Azure Datafactory, Databricks/Spark, dbt, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Tests & Monitoring en/of Git workflows of soortgelijke tools zijn een sterke pré.
  • Je jezelf committeert aan een ontwikkeltraject van 1,5 jaar en beschikbaar bent voor 36-40 uur per week.
Dit krijg je van ons

We bieden een salaris tussen de 3.800 en 6.000 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week passend bij je ervaring en expertise.

Vanuit jouw rol als data analist groei je op opdracht naar een data engineer. Wij zorgen voor passende opdrachten die deze ontwikkeling stap voor stap mogelijk maken. Het ontwikkelprogramma ondersteunt je hierin en versnelt jouw groei naar een volwaardig data engineer. Je volgt praktische trainingen waarin je erkende certificeringen behaalt richting de Azure stack, krijgt coaching van je performance manager en maakt deel uit van een groep die dezelfde ontwikkeling doormaakt. Juist door samen te leren en ervaringen te delen, versnellen jullie elkaars groei.
Klik hier voor onze onepager met alle belangrijke informatie die je nodig hebt voordat je besluit te solliciteren op dit programma!

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van start up tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen team Technology werken we in twee focusgebieden: Data & Analytics en IT. Jij maakt onderdeel uit van Team Data & Analytics, samen met zo'n 35 professionals binnen een unit van 100 specialisten. Onze cultuur is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Het mooie van Technology? We werken niet sectorgebonden. IT en data raken elke sector, daardoor vind je bij ons altijd een project waar jouw kennis, ideeën en energie perfect tot hun recht komen.

Op vrijdag werken we samen in ons clubhuis in Arnhem. Deze dag staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega's en het versterken van de verbinding met Team EIFFEL. Verwacht een opdrachtgever je die dag op locatie? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

EIFFEL is onderdeel van Team EIFFEL: een community van 3.000+ experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en actief bij 600+ opdrachtgevers. Groot in schaal, maar persoonlijk in aanpak. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die zichzelf wil blijven ontwikkelen en voor wil blijven.

#LI-GH1

Deze skills komen van pas
  • SQL
  • RESTful API development
  • Kennis van programma's en portfolio's
  • Kennis van BI-tools
  • ETL processen

Je werkt gestructureerd, denkt in oplossingen en vindt het leuk om dingen te automatiseren. Nieuwsgierigheid en eigenaarschap helpen je om snel meters te maken als Data Engineer.

title: Autonomous Driving Systems Simulation and Data Analysis Engineer
description:
Company Description


CS Group Canada, a subsidiary of CS Group (part of the Sopra Steria Group), is a leader in the development and certification of safety-critical systems in the aerospace, electric, and autonomous driving industries.


CS Group Canada, a subsidiary of CS Group (part of the Sopra Steria Group), is a leader in the development and certification of safety-critical systems in the aerospace, electric, and autonomous driving industries.


Joining CS Group Canada means taking part in complex, high-tech projects for some of the most prestigious system manufacturers in North America, while benefiting from competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and flexible work arrangements.



Job Description


Support the validation and continuous refinement of performance requirements, safety thresholds, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for autonomous driving systems through large-scale simulation and real-world data analysis.


The engineer will leverage simulation, data analytics, and software development to quantify and refine performance, behavioral, and technical requirements necessary to achieve system safety. The role focuses on safety requirements quantification, including latency budgets, safety mechanism thresholds, and checker maturation parameters, while developing and maintaining simulation and analysis tools, and supporting scalable safety validation activities.



Key Responsibilities



Simulation Development & Scenario Execution



  • Develop and maintain simulation tooling in C/C++ and Python to support large-scale autonomous driving validation activities.

  • Design interfaces and integrations between internal validation tools, simulation environments, and data processing frameworks.

  • Extend existing simulation scenarios to inject perception noise, latency, and failure conditions to characterize system robustness.

  • Support containerized development and deployment environments using Docker and Linux-based infrastructure.

  • Use simulation results to support the definition and refinement of subsystem performance requirements and safety thresholds.

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of safety mechanisms under degraded system performance conditions.



Data Analytics & Performance Evaluation



  • Develop and maintain Python- and C/C++-based analysis and simulation pipelines to process, visualize, and evaluate large-scale driving and simulation datasets.

  • Investigate scenarios where unsafe behavior occurs despite performance targets being met and provide data-driven recommendations for improving metrics, thresholds, or requirements.

  • Determine characterization data and quantify system performance against KPIs, SPIs, safety targets, and behavior requirements.



Qualifications



Education



  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.



Experience



  • Experience with validating and quantifying performance criteria for autonomous driving functions such as:


    • Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC)

    • Lane Centering

    • Automated Lane Change

    • Highway Driving Assist

    • Automated Driving / ADS functions


  • Experience analyzing autonomous driving datasets and vehicle performance data.

  • Experience developing production-quality software in C/C++ and/or Python, including tool development, automation, and system integration activities.

  • Experience with Linux-based development environments.

  • Experience integrating software applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated validation workflows.

  • Experience working with autonomous driving software stacks, particularly:


    • Perception

    • Object tracking/fusion

    • Vehicle Intent

    • Prediction

    • Planning

    • Vehicle control interfaces


  • Experience evaluating software and system performance using simulation and real-world validation data.



Desired Skills



Simulation & Scenario-Based Validation



  • Experience with Applied Intuition Simian simulation environments.

  • Experience with Foretellix scenario generation and validation tools.

  • Experience with AV simulation stacks and simulation workflows.

  • Experience developing, generating, and managing simulation scenarios for autonomous driving validation.

  • Experience evaluating ODD coverage and edge-case traffic situations.



Software & Infrastructure



  • Experience integrating simulation, validation, or analytics tools into enterprise software ecosystems.

  • Experience setting up, configuring, and running Docker containers.

  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and large-scale data processing frameworks.

  • Experience developing internal engineering tools and automation frameworks in C/C++ or Python.

  • Experience with build systems such as CMake and software development best practices.



Autonomous Driving & Safety



  • Knowledge of Autonomous Driving Safety Performance Indicators and KPIs.

  • Familiarity with ISO 21448 (SOTIF).

  • Experience supporting safety case development, safety performance evaluation, or safety requirement specification activities.



Additional Information


Please note that only selected candidates and Permanent Residents/Canadian / American Citizens will be contacted.


Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

title: Principal Engineer, Process Development
description:
Why Sarepta? Why Now?

The promise of genetic medicine has arrived, and Sarepta is at the forefront. We hold a leadership position in Duchenne muscular dystrophy (Duchenne) and are building a robust portfolio of programs across muscle, central nervous system, and cardiac diseases. In 2023, we launched our fourth therapy and the first ever gene therapy to treat Duchenne.

We’re looking for people who see unlimited potential in themselves and who are motivated by an unwavering commitment to patients.

What Sarepta Offers

At Sarepta, we care deeply about all the people in our community and believe in the importance of supporting them in all aspects of their lives. We aspire to maintain a culture that acknowledges people bring their whole selves to work, and we will strive to help everyone in our community integrate their work and personal lives while maintaining productivity. We are committed to offering a range of benefits and work-life resources designed to support people in the following areas:

  • Physical and Emotional Wellness

  • ​Financial Wellness

  • Support for Caregivers

For a full list of our comprehensive benefits, see our website:

The Importance of the Role

The Principal Engineer will support development, scale-up, technology transfer, and external manufacturing oversight for Sarepta’s antibody-oligonucleotide conjugate (AOC) and adeno-associated virus (AAV) drug substance programs. This role will provide technical leadership across internal process development and CDMO/CMO manufacturing activities, with responsibility for process robustness, product quality, GMP readiness, technical documentation, and CMC regulatory support.

The Opportunity to Make a Difference

The Principal Engineer, Process Development role is responsible for providing technical leadership across Sarepta’s AOC and AAV drug substance programs, with a focus on process development, scale-up, technology transfer, external manufacturing oversight, and GMP readiness. The position will support internal and CDMO/CMO activities by driving process robustness, product quality, control strategy development, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and CMC regulatory deliverables. The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in complex biologics or bioconjugate manufacturing, hands-on analytical capability such as HPLC, strong knowledge of cGMP and CMC expectations, and the communication and cross-functional leadership skills needed to advance programs from development through late-stage clinical or commercial production.

More about You

Primary Responsibilities include:

  • Lead process development and optimization for AOC and AAV drug substance manufacturing, including conjugation, purification, UF/DF, concentration, harvest, clarification, capture, polishing, and bulk DS handling.
  • Design and execute studies to improve yield, robustness, impurity clearance, and product quality attributes.
  • Provide technical oversight of CDMO/CMO process transfer, engineering runs, GMP batch execution, batch record review, deviations, change assessments, and issue resolution.
  • Execute hands-on HPLC methods to support process development, impurity profiling, in-process testing, and product quality assessment.
  • Develop and maintain drug substance control strategies, including critical process parameters, in-process controls, hold times, raw material controls, and links to critical quality attributes.
  • Support scale-up, technology transfer, process comparability, and manufacturing readiness from development through late-stage clinical or commercial production.
  • Prepare and review technical protocols, development reports, manufacturing summaries, batch record sections, comparability assessments, and CMC regulatory source documents.
  • Troubleshoot development and manufacturing issues related to conjugation, purification, filtration, recovery, AAV productivity, empty/full capsid enrichment, and impurity clearance.
  • Partner with internal functions and external partners to align technical plans, manufacturing readiness, and regulatory deliverables.

Education and Skills Requirements:

  • Ph.D. in chemical engineering, biochemistry, chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, bioengineering, virology, molecular biology, or related field with 3–5+ years of relevant industry experience; MS with 7–9 years or BS with 10+ years may also be considered.
  • Technical background in AOC, antibody-drug conjugates, bioconjugates, oligonucleotide therapeutics, Fab/antibody intermediates, AAV vectors, viral vector manufacturing, or other complex biologics is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on HPLC experience, including method execution, impurity analysis, method troubleshooting, and characterization of biologic or conjugated drug substance products.
  • Strong knowledge of drug substance process development, scale-up, technology transfer, GMP manufacturing, and external CDMO/CMO oversight.
  • Understanding of relevant product quality attributes, including conjugation efficiency, purity, aggregation, residual impurities, vector genome/capsid titer, potency, empty/full capsid ratio, endotoxin, bioburden, and stability-indicating attributes.
  • Ability to interpret process, analytical, characterization, and stability data to support development decisions, investigations, comparability assessments, and regulatory documentation.
  • Working knowledge of cGMP expectations, CMC regulatory requirements, process characterization, validation principles, control strategy development, and lifecycle management.
  • Strong technical writing, communication, troubleshooting, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Experience working with CDMOs/CMOs, external technical teams, or cross-functional development workstreams is preferred.
  • Recognized by peers, colleagues, managers, and direct reports for attributes aligned with Sarepta Values: Drive, Excellence, Resilience, Teamwork, Innovation, and Compassion.

What Now?

We’re always looking for solution-oriented, critical thinkers.

So, if you’re comfortable with ambiguity and candor, relish challenging yourself, and place kindness and integrity at the forefront of how you approach your peers and work, then we encourage you to apply.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About Planet

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced BI Data Analyst to join our dynamic and growing team. In this role, you will drive insights, support data-driven decision-making across key business areas, and collaborate with stakeholders in Payments, Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC), Tax-Free, and Hospitality sectors. You will be instrumental in transforming large-scale datasets into meaningful business recommendations and automated processes, while also contributing to the broader BI strategy.

As part of the BI Analytics team, you’ll work alongside data engineers to ensure scalable ETL processes but maintain a primary focus on analytics. This role offers the opportunity to work autonomously on end-to-end projects, from gathering requirements to delivering impactful solutions using PowerBI, SQL, and other tools. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to mentor and teach others within the team, contributing to the growth of the BI Analytics function.

Core Responsibilities

  • Analyze and Generate Insights:

  • Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in large datasets to drive actionable insights for business stakeholders in Payments, DCC, Tax-Free, and Hospitality.

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced dashboards in PowerBI that are scalable and provide clear insights to support decision-making across the organization.

  • Promote process automation and optimization through BI tools to streamline reporting and analytics.

  • End-to-End Project Management:

  • Lead projects independently from ideation to implementation, collaborating with stakeholders across the organization to define requirements, scope projects, and deliver solutions that drive business value.

  • Act as a translator between technical teams (Data Engineering, etc.) and business stakeholders, ensuring requirements are well understood and implemented accordingly.

  • Collaboration & Teamwork:

  • Collaborate closely with all areas of the business to understand their analytical needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.

  • Collaborate with data engineering to ensure efficient ETL pipelines and data governance practices, contributing to scalable, reliable data models.

  • Stay updated on new tools, methodologies, and best practices in BI and analytics, encouraging innovation within the team.

Key Qualifications & Skills

Technical Skills:

  • PowerBI: Advanced expertise in PowerBI is essential, including experience with DAX, building automated reports, and creating complex, data-driven dashboards.

  • SQL: Strong proficiency in SQL, with experience working with large datasets in a cloud-based environment (Snowflake).

  • Data Modelling: Experience with data modelling and data pipeline processes (using dbt or equivalent).

  • Cloud Platforms: Experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Azure as a plus).

  • ETL: Basic knowledge of ETL processes and experience working with data engineers to contribute to scalable solutions. Familiarity with DBT and GitHub for managing code and version control.

Nice to Have:

  • Azure: Experience with Azure cloud services.

  • Python: Ability to automate data tasks and processes using Python (not mandatory but beneficial).

  • Data Governance: Understanding of data governance and security best practices.

Soft Skills & Behavioral Attributes:

  • Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to approach business problems insightfully and propose creative, data-driven solutions.

  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

  • Self-Starter: Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment and managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Mentorship: Eagerness to mentor others and contribute to team growth, fostering a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable navigating change and quickly adapting to evolving business and technology landscapes.

Why Planet:

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

title: End User Computing Analyst
company: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
description:
The End User Computing Analyst provides technical support for KAUST faculty, staff, and departments by diagnosing, resolving, and preventing hardware, software, and end-user computing issues. The role ensures reliable operation of desktops, laptops, peripherals, and related systems, while maintaining high service standards and contributing to continuous improvement of end-user support services.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve hardware, software, and peripheral issues across University‑supported devices to ensure minimal disruption to users.
  • Install, configure, and maintain personal computers, operating systems, and related equipment, ensuring compliance with KAUST standards and procedures.
  • Provide integrated hardware/software troubleshooting, including resolving system conflicts, failures, and configuration issues.
  • Deliver technical assistance to faculty, staff, and departmental support teams, ensuring timely and professional resolution of service requests.
  • Maintain and track IT assets, including acquisition, distribution, movement, and disposal, ensuring accurate configuration and license records.
  • Identify and address unauthorized or unlicensed software installations to maintain compliance.
  • Conduct hardware and software installations or removals, perform testing, correct malfunctions, and document results according to established procedures.
  • Maintain accurate records of user requests, incidents, resolutions, and change requests within the service management system.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of installation procedures, support standards, and documentation.
  • Provide individual or group training sessions to faculty and staff on end‑user technologies and best practices.
  • Lead small-scale technical projects or sub‑projects (typically under six months), including planning, risk assessment, stakeholder communication, and closure activities.
  • Develop and implement approved changes following established change control processes.
  • Escalate risks, issues, and unresolved incidents to management as required.
  • Mentor junior technicians and support staff, providing guidance and knowledge sharing.
  • Coordinate with the Help Desk and other support teams to ensure consistent handling and timely escalation of end‑user requests and incidents.
  • Provide on‑site support for network and communication equipment issues affecting end‑user devices, escalating complex infrastructure faults to the appropriate specialist teams.
  • Maintain and report on service metrics, including work order status, resolution times, and utilization of support resources, to inform continuous service improvement.
  • Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the scope of the employee’s skills and capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Certifications or training in Windows and macOS support tools and technologies.
  • ACSA or equivalent professional certification.
  • Additional certifications in device management, deployment, or IT service management.
  • Basic knowledge of Linux operating systems.

Required Skills

  • Minimum 6 years of experience providing end-user support in a professional IT environment, including:
  • Hands‑on experience with Windows and macOS remote support tools.
  • Experience with device deployment solutions for Windows and macOS.
  • Experience working with directory services such as Active Directory or Open Directory.
  • Experience leading small technical projects or mentoring junior staff.
  • Experience in higher education or large enterprise environments.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
About Keystone

Keystone is one of the largest and fastest-growing insurance brokerages in the country — ranked #26 among U.S. retail brokers and #4 fastest-growing in the Top 50 by Business Insurance. Our platform spans 33+ states, 180+ agency partners, and more than $500 million in revenue — uniting some of the country's most respected independent agencies with the scale, tools, and resources of a national brokerage. Through operational support in finance, HR, marketing, technology, producer development, and M&A, we empower agencies to grow while preserving what makes them who they are — their client relationships and their role in the communities they serve. Guided by our trademarked commitment, "Trust, our most important policy," Keystone is building the insurance solution every family and business can count on. For more information, visit .

Salesforce Administrator

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Administrator to support the configuration, administration, optimization, and ongoing maintenance of our Salesforce platform. This role is responsible for ensuring Salesforce operates efficiently, securely, and effectively while supporting business objectives across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a customer-focused mindset and a passion for leveraging Salesforce capabilities to solve business challenges. This individual will partner with stakeholders across departments, manage system enhancements, support users, and drive continuous improvements that increase adoption, streamline processes, and enhance the overall user experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary administrator for Salesforce, ensuring platform stability, performance, and ongoing optimization.
  • Analyze support requests and enhancement tickets, troubleshoot issues, and implement scalable solutions.
  • Design, build, and maintain business process automation using Salesforce Flow, approval processes, and other declarative tools.
  • Configure and manage custom objects, fields, record types, page layouts, validation rules, formulas, and related platform components.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance reports and dashboards that provide meaningful insights and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Manage user setup and maintenance, including profiles, permission sets, roles, licenses, and access controls.
  • Ensure adherence to security, compliance, governance, and data management best practices.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into effective Salesforce solutions.
  • Support system testing, release management, change control, and deployment activities.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of system configurations, business processes, integrations, and technical procedures.
  • Provide training, guidance, and ongoing support to end users to maximize adoption and platform effectiveness.
  • Partner with internal teams and third-party vendors to support integrations, enhancements, and strategic initiatives.
  • Stay informed on Salesforce releases, emerging technologies, and industry best practices to recommend continuous improvements.

Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator certification.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience.
  • Insurance industry experience or strong insurance business acumen a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce architecture, security model, data management, and declarative development capabilities.
  • Experience building and maintaining Salesforce Flow automations and business process solutions.
  • Proficiency with Data Loader and other data management tools, including data imports, exports, cleansing, and migration activities.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce deployment and release management tools, including Change Sets.
  • Experience creating meaningful reports and dashboards tailored to business requirements.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis and manipulation.
  • Skilled in creating and maintaining clear, accurate, and consistent documentation for system configurations, business processes, and technical specifications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively engage employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Limited travel will be required.

title: Product Manager
description:
Leidos has an opportunity for a senior Product Manager supporting our Air Force Cloud One Architecture and Common Shared Services (ACSS) contract. The ACSS Product Manager operates at the program / capability level within the Agile construct. This role directly supports the Government Cloud One PM by translating mission needs, customer priorities, operational pain points, and strategic objectives into a clear roadmap, program backlog, and prioritized set of initiatives, epics, and features.

The Product Manager is responsible for ensuring the program is building the right capabilities, in the right order, for the right mission outcomes. They work across Product Owners, technical leads, business owners, stakeholders, and external partner teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, prepare work for execution, and ensure delivered capabilities meet the intent of the Government and the needs of Cloud One users.

Because this role supports the Government PM, the Product Manager should recommend, coordinate, and manage execution alignment, while ensuring final prioritization and direction remain with the Government.

The Cloud One ACSS Product Manager is responsible for managing the program-level product roadmap and backlog in support of the Government Cloud One PM. The Product Manager coordinates across Product Owners, technical teams, business owners, and stakeholders to translate Cloud One priorities into executable initiatives, epics, and features. This role ensures work is aligned to mission value, properly sequenced, ready for PI planning, and traceable from stakeholder need through delivery and validation.

The Product Manager does not replace Product Owners or Scrum Masters. Product Owners manage team-level backlogs and story execution, while Scrum Masters facilitate Agile execution and remove impediments. The Product Manager provides the program-level connective tissue that aligns strategy, priorities, dependencies, and outcomes across the broader ACSS delivery organization.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Maintain the ACSS product vision and roadmap in coordination with the Government PM, Technical Director, Product Owners, and key stakeholders.
  • Manage the program-level backlog, including initiatives, epics, priorities, dependencies, target dates, and delivery status.
  • Translate Government priorities into executable work, ensuring initiatives and epics are clearly defined, scoped, sequenced, and aligned to mission value.
  • Coordinate across Product Owners, helping ensure team-level backlogs align to the broader ACSS roadmap and program priorities.
  • Support prioritization decisions using value, urgency, dependency, risk, capacity, and funding considerations, including WSJF where appropriate.
  • Drive PI planning and planning readiness, including roadmap review, priority alignment, dependency identification, and preparation of top initiatives for execution.
  • Validate that delivered capabilities meet intent, participating in demos, reviews, and stakeholder feedback sessions to determine whether outcomes satisfy the need.
  • Maintain visibility of cross-team dependencies and blockers, ensuring actions are assigned, tracked, and driven to closure.
  • Coordinate with Business Owners, Government stakeholders, and external partners to ensure alignment on expected outcomes, schedule impacts, and delivery priorities.
  • Run Product Management and PO sync meetings, using those forums to maintain roadmap alignment, resolve priority conflicts, and surface decisions needed from the Government PM.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience, including experience supporting complex technical, cloud, software, or IT programs.
  • 5+ years of Program or Product Management, Product Ownership, or equivalent Agile leadership experience managing capabilities across multiple delivery teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with Government customers, technical teams, and senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining product roadmaps and program-level backlogs, including initiatives, epics, features, priorities, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
  • Experience translating customer, mission, and stakeholder needs into prioritized and executable technical work.
  • Demonstrated experience working across Product Owners, engineering teams, technical leadership, business owners, and senior stakeholders to align priorities and delivery outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of Agile and scaled Agile practices, including PI planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, dependency management, demonstrations/reviews, and iterative delivery.
  • Experience preparing initiatives, epics, and features for execution, including defining business/mission value, desired outcomes, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and measures of success.
  • Experience facilitating cross-team planning and prioritization and identifying decisions, risks, dependencies, and blockers requiring leadership attention.
  • Ability to evaluate competing priorities using factors such as mission value, urgency, risk, dependencies, capacity, schedule, and funding.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an environment where the Product Manager develops recommendations and drives alignment while Government leadership retains final prioritization and decision authority.
  • Must have an active Secret Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting DoD, Department of the Air Force, or other Federal Government software, cloud, or digital modernization programs.
  • Experience managing products or capabilities in AWS, Microsoft Azure, or other enterprise cloud environments.
  • Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud security, platform engineering, or enterprise cloud operations.
  • Experience applying SAFe or comparable scaled Agile frameworks in a multi-team environment.
  • Experience using WSJF or similar economic prioritization methods to support program-level decision-making.
  • Experience with Gitlab Project Management, Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, or comparable Agile/product management tooling.
  • Experience developing and facilitating PI Planning, roadmap reviews, Product Management/PO synchronization, and executive-level product reviews.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish traceability from stakeholder or mission need through initiative, epic, feature, delivery, and outcome validation.
  • Experience defining and using product metrics, KPIs, OKRs, or other outcome-based measures to evaluate whether delivered capabilities achieved their intended value.
  • Product Management or Agile certification such as SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner, CSPO, PSPO, PMP/PMI-ACP, or equivalent.
  • Relevant cloud certification from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or comparable provider.

title: Insurance Examiner-In-Charge (Home Based, VT, US)
description:
Overview

As an Examiner-in-Charge (EIC) for the Vermont Department of Financial Regulation, Captive Insurance Division, your primary responsibilities include examinations and ongoing oversight of Vermont domiciled captive insurance companies. Utilizing a risk-focused approach, an EIC leads a team of examiners in evaluating areas of captive insurance company operations and business practices, including corporate governance, strategy, business plan, IT systems, internal controls, financial reporting and regulatory compliance. An EIC also conducts research, is assigned special projects, and conducts annual and quarterly surveillance for a portfolio of companies. An EIC must be self motivated and possess strong time management, organization, critical thinking and communication skills.

Who May Apply

This position, Insurance Examiner-In-Charge (Job Requisition #52725), is open to all State employees and external applicants.

If you would like more information about this position, please contact .

Resumes will not be accepted via e-mail. You must apply online to be considered.

Minimum Qualifications

Graduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field AND two (2) or more years of experience at or above a technical level in accounting, auditing, or financial examination, INCLUDING two (2) or more years involving insurance operations and supervisory responsibilities.

OR

Bachelor's degree AND four (4) or more years of experience at or above a technical level in accounting, auditing, or financial examination, INCLUDING two (2) or more years involving insurance operations and supervisory responsibilities.

OR

One year as an Insurance Examiner III.

Preferred Qualifications

AFE (Accredited Financial Examiner), CFE (Certified Financial Examiner), or CPA (Certified Public Accountant) designations.

Special Requirements

Total Compensation

  • 80% State paid medical premium and a dental plan at no cost for employees and their families

title: Clinical Director-Cardiovascular Services
description:
If you are looking to make an impact on a meaningful scale, come join us as we embrace the Power of One!

We strive to be an employer of choice and establish a reputation for being a talent rich organization where Associates can grow their career caring for others. For over a century, we’ve served the health care needs of the people of Memphis and the Mid-South.

Plans, implements, directs and controls cardiovascular services activities and operations such as Cath Lab, Electrophysiology, Structural Heart and other selected departments for the assigned facility(s), in accordance with professional and MLH standards of practice. Models appropriate behavior as exemplified in MLH Mission, Vision and Values.


Working at MLH means carrying the mission forward of caring for our community and impacting the lives of patients in every way through compassion, a deliberate focus on service expectations and a consistent thriving for excellence.

A Brief Overview
Plans, implements, directs and controls cardiovascular services activities and operations such as Cath Lab, Electrophysiology, Structural Heart and other selected departments for the assigned facility(s), in accordance with professional and MLH standards of practice. Models appropriate behavior as exemplified in MLH Mission, Vision and Values.

What you will do
  • Plans, organizes, implements, and controls cardiovascular services activities and operations at assigned facility(s); monitors operations to ensure standards and objectives are being met; develops and implements limited or short-term plans to keep operations moving smoothly.
  • Formulates long-range business plans for cardiovascular service operations; sets goals and develops strategies for meeting those goals; anticipates possible problems and prepares contingent strategies.
  • Directs the activities of Associates and students; monitors Associates performance and clarifies work expectations, and assists with goal setting; promotes cooperation among individuals and groups. Develops and implements processes through orientation, training and education to ensure that the competence of all staff members is assessed, maintained, improved and demonstrated throughout their employment.
  • Develops and administers capital and expense budgets for operational areas, authorizes expenditures, and monitors budget and other financial indicators. Assists in the development and implementation of plans to control costs and improve department operations.
  • Develops and maintains performance standards to include quality assessment/improvement programs. Develops and recommends procedures to standardize operations, improve operational efficiency, and provide quality services.
  • Investigates trends and developments in cardiovascular practice; introduces new procedures.
  • Establishes policies/practices for the department in accordance with current regulatory and professional practice guidelines. Interprets, executes, and recommends policy modifications.
  • Provides leadership for educational programs for students and staff in collaboration with the administrative team.
  • Advances the profession through participation in professional organizations, and completes the required continuous training and education to include department specific requirements.
  • Ensures good working relationships between departments; serves as a resource and liaison for advanced problem solving related to cardiovascular services. Responsible for monitoring of patient and employee satisfaction. Conducts root cause analyses to determine and correct underlying issues.
  • Oversees supply management of each department. Introduces new products through the system process and submits or maintains contracts in the contract management system.

Education/Formal Training Requirements
  • Required - Bachelor's Degree Business Administration/Management
  • Preferred - Bachelor's Degree Healthcare
  • Preferred - Bachelor's Degree Healthcare Administration
  • Preferred - Bachelor's Degree Nursing

Work Experience Requirements
  • Required - Progressive management in cardiovascular services 5-7 years

Licenses and Certifications Requirements
  • Required - BASIC LIFE SUPPORT - American Heart Association
  • Required - Registered Nurse Tennessee - Tennessee Board of Nursing
  • Preferred - Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer - American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography
  • Preferred - Registered Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist - Cardiovascular Credentialing International
  • Preferred - Registered Radiologic Technologist - American Registry of Radiologic Technologists
  • Preferred - Registered Vascular Technologist - American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography
  • Preferred - Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer - Obstetrics and Gynecology - American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography
  • Preferred - Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer - Pediatric Echocardiography - American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography
  • Preferred - Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer - Fetal Echocardiography - American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography
  • Preferred - Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer - Adult Echocardiography - American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography
  • Preferred - Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer -Breast - American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography
  • Preferred - Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer - Neurosonology - American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography
  • Preferred - Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer - Abdomen - American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography
  • Preferred - Registered Respiratory Therapist - Mississippi - Mississippi State Department of Health
  • Preferred - Registered Respiratory Therapist - Tennessee - Tennessee Board of Respiratory Care

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Thorough knowledge of clinical practice, procedures, and regulatory standards gained through work related experience.
  • Ability to understand and prepare complex written materials.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with all levels of Associates, management, physicians, and patients and their families.
  • Ability to lead and motivate individuals and groups of people toward the accomplishment of work and organizational goals.
  • Skill in negotiating with and between individuals and groups of people, including Associates, management and physicians.
  • Ability to plan and schedule tasks and projects and to maintain control of own and others’ work flow.
  • Skill in developing and implementing long-range plans and programs.
  • Ability to work without close supervision or professional guidance and to exercise independent judgment.

Supervision Provided by this Position
  • Provides direct and/or indirect supervision for Associates assigned to the cardiovascular services department(s). Cardiovascular Services includes Cath Lab, Electrophysiology, Structural Heart and other selected departments to meet individual facility needs.

Physical Demands
  • The physical activities of this position may include climbing, pushing, standing, hearing, walking, reaching, grasping, kneeling, stooping, and repetitive motion.
  • Must have good balance and coordination.
  • The physical requirements of this position are: medium work - exerting up to 50 lbs. of force occasionally and/or up to 25 lbs. of force frequently.
  • The Associate is required to have close visual acuity including color, depth perception, and field of vision to perform an activity, such as assessing patients, preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; or extensive reading.
  • Frequent invasive and non-invasive patient contact.
  • Exposure to patient body fluids as well as exposure to hazardous or poisonous materials.
  • Ability to react quickly to emergency situations.

Our Associates are passionate about what they do, the service they provide and the patients they serve. We value family, team and a Power of One culture that requires commitment to the highest standards of care and unity.


Boasting one of the South's largest medical centers, Memphis blends a friendly community, a thriving and growing downtown, and a low cost of living. We see each day as a new opportunity to make a difference in the lives of the people in our community.

title: Licensed Psychologist - Fee For Service
description:
Thriveworks is currently seeking Licensed Clinicians to provide a mix of telehealth and face-to-face sessions in Lubbock, TX. This role is eligible for a competitive ramp stipend for clinicians offering 30+ hours of availability per week.

About the job

Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role

We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Independently licensed and living in Texas — Licensed Psychologist (PsyD or PhD)

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 25 sessions with 30 hours of availability weekly

  • A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

  • Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

  • Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

  • A good teammate — we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation

Up to $122,400.00 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities. Full-time clinicians are eligible for health insurance, student loan repayment assistance, paid time off, and other employer-sponsored benefits.

How We Support You

We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.

Benefits

As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:

  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Paid time off

  • Short- and long-term disability insurance

  • Company-paid life and AD&D insurance

  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

  • Student loan repayment assistance

  • Opportunities for paid clinical supervisor roles in select states

Our Community

Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.

title: Freelance Presentation Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.
  • Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.
  • Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.
  • Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.
  • Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.
  • Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.
  • Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.
  • Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

Additional requirements

  • Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.
  • Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

$5,000.00 Sign on Bonus currently available**. (Not applicable to internal employees.)

This is your chance to make your mark. Introducing our customers to the world’s most robust network all while delivering best-in-class service. You’re the key to elevating the customer experience, providing seamless installation and activation of our state-of-the-art technology. And you’ll get the satisfaction of helping others and connecting our customers to what matters most to them every day. #connectourcustomers

Our Installation Technicians earn between $20.09 and $35.65 hourly. With our amazing wage opportunities, our average starting earnings begin at $57,970 per year. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training.

  • Joining our team comes with amazing perks and benefits: Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
  • 401(k) plan
  • Tuition reimbursement program
  • Paid Time off and holidays (With some exceptions bargained employees qualify for one week of PTO after 6 months of service and 2 weeks after the first year). At least 6 company designated holidays and additional PTO (based on bargaining group to which you are hired.
  • Sick leave
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Adoption Reimbursement
  • Disability Benefits (short term and long term)
  • Life and Accidental Death Insurance
  • Supplemental benefit programs: critical illness, accident hospital indemnity/group legal
  • Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
  • Employee discounts up to 50% off on eligible AT&T mobility plans and accessories, AT&T internet (and fiber where available) and AT&T phone

What’s a typical day like? You’ll work independently at our customer’s homes and businesses as a trusted expert, installing the latest technology for high-speed broadband, Wi-Fi, and voice services. You’ll have the opportunity to meet new people every day while solving problems and being rewarded for doing great work. Whether you’re putting in a new line, climbing a ladder or simply plugging in and activating a Wi-Fi network, one thing is true, no two days will be the same.

Want to be considered? You’ll need to:

  • Work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends.
  • Possess a valid state driver’s license.
  • Lift and move up-to 60 lbs. – some of our ladders weigh 50-60 lbs.
  • Weigh less than 325 lbs., required for ladder safety.
  • At times work in small spaces or aloft (up to 28 ft.)
  • Be available for overtime, emergency callouts and holiday work.
  • Identify wire and cable colors.
  • Qualify on pre-employment assessments.
  • Have a High School Diploma or GED

Interested? We provide extensive training and the resources you need in a collaborative and dynamic team environment, built for your success. You’ll have the opportunity to continue to learn and grow with ongoing paid training, leading you to exciting career paths.

If you are considering jobs like Maintenance Technician, Cable Installation Technician, Fiber Technician, Facility Technician or Telecommunications Technician, this career move would be a great fit!

Ready to take your career on the road to success? Apply today!

title: Vice President, Middle Office Operations
description:
Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.

Job Description

SUMMARY

Ares Management is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Vice President to join the Middle Office team in New York. The Middle Office team serves as a critical link between multiple groups such as Deal Teams, Treasury, Data, Legal, Compliance, Accounting, and external counterparties, ensuring the efficient execution and support of private credit transactions across Ares' global investment platform.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in private credit operations, a strong control mindset, and proven ability to lead teams, drive operational enhancements, and support business growth in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the end-to-end execution of private credit transactions across Ares’ global investment platform, overseeing deal closings, funding, agency coordination, settlement activities, and wire processing to ensure seamless and timely execution.
  • Oversee trade and position booking, data integrity, and cash and position reconciliations to ensure accuracy throughout the investment lifecycle.
  • Partner closely with Deal Teams during transaction structuring, closings, fundings, amendments, and restructurings to ensure operational readiness and successful execution.
  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships across Investment Operations, Deal Teams, Legal, Compliance, Accounting, Treasury, and Investor Relations to facilitate effective execution and issue resolution.
  • Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and operating model enhancements that increase scalability and support growing transaction volumes and investment complexity.

QUALIFICATIONS

Core Competencies

  • Proven people leadership skills, with experience managing, developing, and mentoring a team to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills, with the ability to partner effectively across investment teams, internal functions, counterparties, and service providers.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence outcomes, prioritize competing demands, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • High attention to detail combined with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach.
  • Analytical and process-driven mindset with a demonstrated track record of delivering operational improvements and scalable solutions.
  • Strong control mindset with the ability to identify risks, solve complex operational challenges, and drive effective outcomes

Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 7-10+ years of investment operations experience supporting credit, private markets, or alternative investment strategies
  • Strong understanding of private credit and alternative investment products, including bank loans, direct lending, structured credit, and insurance-related investment strategies
  • Knowledge of insurance-related investment platforms and capital structures, including experience supporting insurance-oriented investment strategies, is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage high transaction volumes, tight deadlines, and complex deal workflows in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience leading teams, managing third-party service providers, and partnering with senior stakeholders across business functions.

Reporting Relationships

Principal, Middle Office

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role.

$190,000 - $210,000

The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long-Term Disability (LTD) and Short-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit.

Ares offers a number of additional benefits including access to a world-class medical advisory team, a mental health app that includes coaching, therapy and psychiatry, a mindfulness and wellbeing app, financial wellness benefit that includes access to a financial advisor, new parent leave, reproductive and adoption assistance, emergency backup care, matching gift program, education sponsorship program, and much more.

There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.
