title: Crop Insurance Adjuster
description:
Role Details

Job Title: Crop Insurance Adjuster

Location: Remote-Oklahoma

Reports To: Area Claims Supervisor

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Requisition ID: 2026-842

Requisition Begin Date: 8/20/2026

Requisition End Date: 9/20/2026 (Posting may close earlier if filled or business needs change.)

Role Overview:

ProAg has an exciting opportunity for a Crop Adjuster to join our team in Southwest Oklahoma. Imagine joining a team that’s part of an organization that shares your passion for American Agriculture. A team that understands the challenges ag producers face and the disproportionate financial risks they shoulder. How do you know this team has that passion and understanding? Because many of us at ProAg still farm and ranch ourselves or were raised on the farm or ranch. It’s in our blood.

As a ProAg Crop Adjuster, you will make first contact with our policy holder on the farm or ranch that has just experienced a loss. You will work with our customer to complete field inspections, read maps and aerial photos, measure fields and storage bins, collecting production records of farm commodities, all the while assessing damage or loss. You’ll stick with each claim for each grower until the work is done and the claim is settled.

Reporting to the Area Claims Supervisor, you will work regularly in the field on the farms, climbing grain bins, walking over rough terrain for long distances, etc. You will apply your good judgment, common sense and understanding of ProAg's adjusting guidelines and policy provisions for a variety of Multi-Peril Crop Insurance, Crop Hail, and Named Peril policies.

In this position, you will work from home and cover a territory in the state of Oklahoma. This position will require travel of up to 75%, occasionally even beyond your assigned territory.

In this Exciting Opportunity, You Will:

  • Perform fact-finding to determine cause(s) and percentage of loss, exercising your best independent judgment in the handling of claims. Escalate any issues or problems that you can’t resolve to the Area Claims Supervisor.
  • Convey regulations and interpretation of procedure to claimants, agents, and industry people on claim situations.
  • Effectively communicate our position on developing industry topics such as new specialty crops or expanding coverage programs.
  • Continuously expand your knowledge of RMA rules and regulations and ProAg procedures for applying all MPCI, Crop Hail, and Federal Crop Insurance regulations.

What You Bring:

  • High school diploma
  • Crop insurance experience in claims or compliance or any ag-related experience and background
  • Analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Basic computer and internet applications
  • Communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills
  • Reliable means of transportation and the willingness to travel
  • Completion of your Claim Adjuster Proficiency Program (CAPP) certification and/or any applicable licenses required by State agencies preferred.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package
  • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment
  • Basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with 6% company match
  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
  • Student loan matching program
  • Employee discount program
  • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent:

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.

  • Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.
  • Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.
  • A team who cares: We look out for each other personally and professionally because we care about each other.
  • Innovators by trade: We’re committed to a brighter tomorrow for our team members and agriculture.
  • The best of both worlds: We combine personal connections with powerful resources, thanks to our culture and the backing of Tokio Marine HCC.

The Company:

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service.

Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability that comes from being a member of the Tokio Marine Group, and more than fifty years of growth, profitability, and stability, we offer important insurance products that most people don’t even know exist. Every policy we write is special, enabling our clients to do amazing things.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

TMHCC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Software Lifecycle Product Owner
description:
Job title: Software Lifecycle Product Owner

  • Location: Hyderabad

About the job

At Opella, we have one shared mission – we work passionately, every day, to ‘serve healthier, fuller lives’ now and for the generations to come.

In order to do so, we strive to act as a force for good by integrating sustainability along our business and employees’ mission and operate responsibly from both a social and environmental point of view.

Everything we do is centered around people’s interests – our consumers, our customers, healthcare professionals, and our employees – across the world.

We are building loved brands that serve 1bn consumers worldwide, through our key platforms: Allergy, Physical & Mental Wellness, Pain, Digestive Wellness and Cough, Cold & Flu.

We aspire to become the best Fast Moving Consumer Health (FMCH) company In & For the world and we aim to build a work environment where people can thrive, grow, enjoy and be at their best.

Our team

Our team is engaged in designing, delivering and supporting Digital Tech Services for all CHC worldwide.

We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations).

Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world.

Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e.g. DevOps & related framework), Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, SAP, Commercial, RPA, …), Digital Workplace and more “classical” infrastructures (hosting, servers, …).

Digital Workplace & Facilities team manages all Digital Workplace capabilities (all devices, collaboration, communication, printing, software management & deployment, …) and makes the bridge between global standards designed by global infrastructure & workplace teams and their implementation on our 60+ sites (incl. 12 plants) across the globe.

Are you passionate about providing exceptional Digital Workplace services that serve all our users every minute of their daily work? Influencing the way our associates collaborate and communicate? Join us to as a Software Lifecycle Product Owner within our Device Experience and DEX crew!

As part of the Device Experience and DEX team, you will manage the following capabilities:

  • Enterprise App Store Management.
  • Software Asset Management (SAM).
  • End-User Software Management.
  • Application Lifecycle Automation.
  • Software Deployment & Delivery.
  • Application Compatibility & Testing.
  • Software Compliance & Governance.
  • Cost Optimization & Financial Management.

We are looking for a Digital Workplace Software Lifecycle in our Device Experience and DEX team, with following core responsibilities, for all capabilities listed above.

Main Responsibilities

1. Enterprise App Store Management

  • Own and manage enterprise application stores including Microsoft Intune Company Portal, Microsoft Store for Business, and private app repositories.
  • Design and implement a software catalogue strategy that provide self-service capabilities for end users.
  • Curate and maintain application collections for different user personas and departments.
  • Implement app approval workflows and governance processes.
  • Manage app publishing, updates, and retirement processes across all platforms (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android).
  • Design and implement featured apps, app categories, and user-friendly browsing experiences.
  • Integrate app stores with identity management (Azure AD, SSO) and conditional access policies.
  • Monitor app store usage analytics, adoption rates, and user satisfaction metrics.
  • Develop automated app deployment strategies based on user groups, devices, and business requirements.
  • Manage app store branding, customization, and user communications.

2. Software Asset Management (SAM):

  • Implement and manage comprehensive Software Asset Management program ensuring license compliance and cost optimization.
  • Deploy and administer SAM tools (Snow License Manager, ServiceNow SAM or similar platforms)
  • Conduct regular software license audits and reconciliation processes.
  • Maintain accurate software inventory across all devices, VDI environments, and cloud services.
  • Develop software license optimization strategies identifying over-licensed and under-utilized software.
  • Track software license entitlements, allocations, and renewals.
  • Implement automated discovery and inventory collection mechanisms.
  • Generate compliance reports and dashboards for audit readiness.
  • Develop chargebacks and cost allocation models for software consumption.
  • Manage software license harvesting and reallocation processes.
  • Ensure compliance with software vendor licensing terms and audit requirements.

3. End-User Software Management – Adobe/Microsoft Products & Third Party:

  • Own Adobe Creative Cloud enterprise deployment and lifecycle management.
  • Manage Adobe Admin Console including user provisioning, product assignments, and license management.
  • Implement Adobe packages using Creative Cloud Packager or Adobe Remote Update Manager.
  • Deploy Adobe applications via Intune, SCCM, or other deployment tools with automation.
  • Manage Adobe license types (Named User, Shared Device, Device licenses).
  • Implement Adobe update policies and patch management strategies.
  • Optimize Adobe licensing costs through usage analytics and license reclamation.
  • Help to manage the Adobe enterprise agreements and consumption-based licensing.
  • Integrate Adobe authentication with Azure AD/SSO
  • Support specialized Adobe deployments for creative teams, marketing departments, and remote workers
  • Manage Adobe plugins, extensions, and third-party integrations.
  • Own Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise deployment strategies.
  • Manage Microsoft 365 Apps deployment using Intune or Configuration Manager.
  • Implement update channels (Current, Monthly Enterprise, Semi-Annual) based on business requirements.
  • Manage Office 365 licensing (E3, E5, Business Premium, etc.) and feature assignments.
  • Deploy and manage Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint clients, and other Microsoft applications
  • Implement Office customization files.
  • Manage Office activation methods including shared computer activation for VDI
  • Optimize Microsoft licensing including Windows 10/11 Enterprise, Azure AD Premium.
  • Manage Microsoft Store for Business integration with Intune.
  • Manage enterprise software portfolio including browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox), collaboration tools, productivity applications, and line-of-business software.
  • Implement software packaging and repackaging strategies using tools like MSIX, App-V, or traditional MSI/EXE.
  • Develop application compatibility testing processes for new OS versions and updates.
  • Manage application dependencies, prerequisites, and installation sequences.
  • Implement application superdense and replacement strategies
  • Manage software uninstallation and cleanup processes.
  • Coordinate software deployments with change management and maintenance windows.

4. Application Lifecycle Automation:

  • Design and implement software deployment strategies across multiple platforms (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, VDI)
  • Manage deployment tools including Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, and third-party solutions.
  • Implement phased deployment approaches with pilot groups and production rollouts.
  • Develop user communication strategies for software changes and new application availability.
  • Manage software deployment scheduling to minimize business impact.
  • Implement software deployment reporting and success rate tracking.
  • Coordinate with application owners and business stakeholders for deployment planning.
  • Manage emergency software patches and security updates.

5. Software Deployment & Delivery:

  • Implement and manage DEX platforms (Intune Analytics)
  • Monitor and analyze end-user computing experience across physical devices, mobile devices, and VDI.
  • Develop proactive alerting and remediation workflows based on user experience metrics.
  • Create dashboards and reports measuring device performance, application responsiveness, and user satisfaction scores.
  • Identify and resolve experience bottlenecks affecting productivity.
  • Implement sentiment analysis and digital experience scoring.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on DEX insights.
  • Collaborate with IT teams to optimize infrastructure based on real user experience data.

6. Application Compatibility & Testing:

  • Establish application compatibility testing processes for OS upgrades (Windows 11, macOS updates)
  • Coordinate application compatibility testing with business application owners.
  • Manage application remediation efforts for compatibility issues.
  • Maintain application compatibility matrix and documentation.
  • Implement automated application testing in pilot environments.
  • Coordinate with software vendors for application compatibility certifications.

7. Software Compliance & Governance:

  • Establish software governance policies including approved software lists, prohibited software, and exception processes.
  • Implement software compliance monitoring and unauthorized software detection.
  • Manage software security policies including application control (AppLocker, WDAC).
  • Conduct regular software compliance reviews with business units.
  • Manage software exemption requests and approvals.
  • Ensure adherence to corporate software standards and policies.
  • Coordinate with security and compliance teams for software risk assessments.
  • Gather requirements and prioritize feature requests from factory managers, IT support, and end users.
  • Track KPIs including device uptime, mean time to resolution, printing costs, and user experience scores.
  • Drive adoption of new technologies and solutions across the organization.

8. Cost Optimization & Financial Management:

  • Develop software cost optimization strategies through license right-sizing and harvesting.
  • Implement software usage analytics to identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Manage software budgets and forecasting for renewals and new acquisitions.
  • Track software spend across departments and implement chargeback models.
  • Identify opportunities for license consolidation and standardization.

About You

Technical background required.

  • Extensive experience implementing and managing SAM programs in enterprise environments
  • Hands-on experience with SAM tools (Snow License Manager, ServiceNow SAM, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of software licensing models (perpetual, subscription, concurrent, named user, device-based).
  • Experience conducting software license audits and vendor compliance reviews
  • Knowledge of major software vendor licensing (Microsoft, Adobe, Oracle, IBM, SAP).
  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft Intune Company Portal and Microsoft Store for Business management
  • Experience designing and implementing enterprise app catalogues and self-service portals
  • Understanding of app publishing workflows and approval processes across platforms.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Adobe Creative Cloud enterprise administration.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Admin Console, Creative Cloud Packager, and Remote Update Manager.
  • Understanding of Adobe licensing models (Named User, Shared Device, Device licenses).
  • Experience deploying Adobe products at scale across diverse environments.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft 365 Apps for Enterprise deployment and management.
  • Understanding of Microsoft 365 licensing and feature management.
  • Experience with Office update channels and servicing strategies.
  • Advanced experience with software packaging technologies (MSI, MSIX, App-V, MSIX-Core)
  • Hands-on experience with deployment tools (Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, third-party tools)
  • Understanding of application compatibility testing and remediation.
  • Experience with silent installation parameters, transforms, and custom actions.
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting for software deployment and management automation.
  • Experience with Microsoft Graph API for Intune and Azure AD integration.
  • Strong understanding of Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS, and Android application management.
  • Experience with VDI application delivery (App-V, MSIX App Attach, application layering).
  • Knowledge of Azure AD, Conditional Access, and identity-driven application assignment.
  • Understanding of application security including AppLocker, WDAC, and application control.
  • Advanced Power BI skills for creating software usage, compliance, and cost optimization dashboards.
  • Experience with SQL queries for custom reporting from SAM and deployment databases.
  • Ability to create executive-level reports and KPI tracking.

General.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software lifecycle management and product ownership roles.
  • Experience with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) for request and change management.
  • Understanding of ITIL service management and software change control processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and manage product roadmaps for software services.
  • Experience gathering requirements from diverse stakeholders and translating them into technical solutions.
  • Ability to manage software budgets and financial planning.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and iterative delivery approaches.
  • Proven ability to drive cost optimization initiatives with measurable results.

Soft skills required.

Fluent in English.

  • Curious and open-minded, « out of the box » thinking with growth mindset, willing to stay up to date with emerging trends and technologies in device management and automation.
  • Proven experience working & performing in global team, in a matrix organization, with strong capacity to manage activities across web meetings and collaborative solutions.
  • Ability to lead & take ownership even in unclear situations. Contribute to clear the unclear
  • Ability to provide innovative solutions, propose ideas to solve a problem by implementing them.
  • Agile and continuous improvement mindset, with critical-thinking and root-cause-analysis paradigms.
  • Able to write and speak fluently in English for any audience

Why us?

At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.

We Are Challengers.

We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:

All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.

Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.

Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.

Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.

Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

title: Retail Backroom associate
description:
HomeGoods

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Opportunity: Grow Your Career

Responsible for delivering a highly satisfied customer experience proven by engaging and interacting with all customers, embodying customer experience principles and philosophy, and maintaining a clean and organized store environment. Adheres to all operational, merchandise, and loss prevention standards. May be cross-trained to work in multiple areas of the store in order to support the needs of the business.

  • Role models established customer experience practices with internal and external customers
  • Supports and embodies a positive store culture through honesty, integrity, and respect

location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
description:
About Oshkosh AeroTech, an Oshkosh company

Oshkosh AeroTech is a leading provider of aviation ground support products, gate equipment and airport services to commercial airlines, airports, air-freight carriers, ground handling and military customers. Oshkosh AeroTech offers products that make a difference in people’s lives by supporting those in our communities who do some of the toughest work. They own many of the most trusted brands in the air transportation industry, including LEKTRO®, JetAire®, JetPower®, AmpTekÔ, Jetway®, and more.

Join Oshkosh AeroTech as a Maintenance Repair Technician I, where you will help maintain, troubleshoot, and repair Passenger Boarding Bridges (PBBs) and related gate equipment. This role responds to routine equipment faults, outages, and service interruptions; performs preventive maintenance and standard corrective repairs; and assists senior technicians with more complex repairs.

OUR BENEFITS

Joining Oshkosh AeroTech means becoming a valued member of a dynamic team with a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, 401K, and more!

YOUR IMPACT

These duties are not meant to be all-inclusive and other duties may be assigned.

  • Respond to passenger loading bridge and ancillary equipment faults, malfunctions, and outages.

  • Use manuals, schematics, testing equipment, and supervisor guidance to diagnose issues, replace parts, and restore equipment operation.

  • Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, troubleshooting, and standard mechanical/electrical repairs on passenger loading bridges, PCA systems, GPUs, and related gate equipment.

  • Escalate complex failures, controls issues, repeat problems, safety concerns, or repairs requiring approval.

  • Assist senior technicians with complex repairs, emergency maintenance, and escalated issues.

  • Document work performed, equipment status, parts used, and repair activity in CMMS.

  • Follow OEM procedures, lockout/tagout requirements, airport rules, company policies, PPE requirements, and all applicable safety/training requirements.

  • Maintain tools, equipment, parts, and work areas in a clean and safe condition.

  • Support 24/7 airport operations, including nights, weekends, holidays, emergency response, and work in ramp areas, tight spaces, and elevated areas as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Valid Driver’s License.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain necessary airport security clearances.

  • Minimum 1 year of mechanical, electrical, industrial maintenance, airport equipment, or related experience; or demonstrated mechanical aptitude.

  • Basic mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.

  • Ability to read and follow technical instructions, work orders, repair manuals, basic schematics, and safety procedures.

  • Ability to work variable schedules to support 24/7 airport operations, including day or night shifts, weekends, holidays, and on-call assignments as needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or GED preferred; equivalent mechanical, electrical, industrial maintenance, airport equipment, or related experience may be considered.

  • Previous airport, aviation, industrial maintenance, field service, or facility maintenance experience.

  • Familiarity of motors, sensors, control panels, PLCs, HMIs, mechanical drives, and electrical schematics.

  • Experience using CMMS software.

  • Basic computer skills, including word processing and spreadsheets.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of the Maintenance Repair Technician I, the employee is regularly required to stand, sit, walk, use hands and fingers to handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, talk, and hear. The employee is frequently required to climb, balance, work from ladders, and work in small or elevated spaces. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment is similar to airport operations with vehicular traffic, aircraft activity, and heavy equipment. The employee may be exposed to moving mechanical parts, elevated work areas, outside weather conditions, fumes or airborne particles, chemicals, cold, vibration, and loud noise. Employees will work on an airport ramp around aircraft and related airport equipment.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
The Defense Sector at Leidos has a current job opportunity for a DevOps Engineer supporting the C4ISR Solutions Operation. The DevOps Engineer will guide the definition, implementation, and delivery of programs focused on modernizing a variety of software systems. The selected candidate will leverage their skills in infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and software deployment across the software development lifecycle. In this role, there is the potential to support multiple contracts to help provide growth and broaden opportunities within Leidos.

This position will primarily be worked on site in Omaha, NE but will support a hybrid working schedule with up to 25% worked from home.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Assist in providing input and expertise to senior engineers to maintain alignments with best practices and recommend system improvements while overseeing the automated deployment, roll-back, and monitoring of applications into software development, test, and production environment.

  • Develop automated CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI

  • Contribute to various software deployment strategies leveraging Kubernetes, Helm, Docker/Podman, and Ansible.

  • Apply DevOps expertise to ensure congruence of the various infrastructure, software, configurations and interfaces maintained under configuration control.

  • Work with Agile software development teams, communicating and collaborating frequently with teammates to ensure successful completion of project objectives.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve software deployment issues.

  • Proactively and independently identify, report, monitor, and assist with mitigation of technical risks.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience or a Master’s degree with 1+ years of experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance within 180 days of your start date with Leidos.

  • Knowledge and understanding of DevOps trends and technologies.

  • Experience designing, building and deploying DevOps pipelines with GitLab CI.

  • Experience with container technologies, such as Docker or Podman, and container orchestration tools, such as Kubernetes.

  • Understanding of basic networking protocols/functions (e.g., HTTP, HTTPS, SSL/TLS, SMTP, DNS.) and how they work in Kubernetes architecture.

  • Experience with Linux/UNIX command line.

  • Excellent problem solving and analysis skills, including the ability to logically create structure and order from unstructured inputs.

  • Self-starter that can work independently while possessing communication skills to work effectively with software development teams, customers, and senior program leadership.

  • Requires an active DoD Secret clearance with the ability to obtain a TS.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • US Citizen with an active Top Secret clearance.

  • Professional cybersecurity certification such as Security+, or similar.

  • Experience designing and implementing application deployment pipelines and developing software in a containerized environment with Kubernetes and Docker.

  • Experience with Kubernetes application deployment/management tools such as Helm or Kustomize.

  • Full software lifecycle automation experience (design, development, test, deployment), including deployment to a production environment.

  • Previous SCM experience, including release planning, managing software baselines, merging branches, and producing software builds.

  • Experience working with Agile software development teams and implementing continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.

  • Experience developing and deploying software in a DoD environment, including experience building and deploying software applications that meet DoD security standards and updating applications and code to meet security scans and security implementation guidelines (e.g. STIGs).

  • Experience with USSTRATCOM ISPAN domain.

title: Sound Design Team Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for a hands-on Sound Design Team Manager responsible for defining audio standards, ensuring quality and performance, and leading the development of the sound design function across slot and other game products, while remaining personally and actively involved in sound design and music production. The role oversees the audio pipeline, delivery, and scalability of the team in alignment with product and business goals.

This role combines hands-on production—personally creating and implementing high-quality audio—with ownership of the audio function and close collaboration across Product, Development, and Art teams. The Sound Design Team Manager ensures that sound design consistently supports player engagement, reward mechanics, and long-session comfort across multiple concurrent titles.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Personally design and produce high-quality sound effects, music, and audio implementation for key titles, remaining a hands-on contributor and setting the creative and technical benchmark for the team.

• Take ownership of the most challenging, high-visibility, and technically demanding audio work, while using personal craft to enhance player engagement and reinforce reward mechanics.

• Define and maintain the overall audio direction, creative vision, and quality standards across all products, ensuring a consistent, polished audio experience.

• Align with Product, Development, and Art stakeholders on the audio vision and requirements for each project, and approve final audio output before stakeholder presentations.

• Establish and uphold standards for sound design, music composition, implementation, performance, and optimization, balancing creative impact with long-session listening comfort and technical constraints.

• Regularly review team output and provide clear, constructive feedback to ensure consistency, quality, and continuous improvement.

• Define and evolve the sound design team structure, including roles, responsibilities, ownership, and reporting lines.

• Oversee team capacity, hiring needs, scaling, and long-term capability development, while supporting and developing the Lead Game Sound Designer and Sound Designer(s).

• Define clear performance expectations, ownership, accountability, and evaluation frameworks for the audio team.

• Oversee audio delivery across multiple concurrent projects and align the audio roadmap with company timelines, product priorities, and business goals.

• Establish and continuously improve audio pipelines and workflows, including asset naming, documentation, version control, and delivery standards.

• Identify and communicate production risks early, proactively addressing capacity, technical, and delivery challenges.

• Guide the team in balancing creative sound design with memory, platform, performance, and other technical requirements.

• Provide regular updates on audio progress, risks, achievements, and key priorities to relevant stakeholders.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in sound design for games, iGaming, or visual media, including demonstrated leadership experience.

• Strong personal portfolio showcasing high-quality sound design, music composition, and implementation work — this role continues to produce, not only manage.

• Proven track record managing or overseeing sound design/audio teams and workflows.

• Proven experience creating UI sounds, SFX, and music for visual media.

• Advanced proficiency in DAWs such as Ableton Live or Reaper.

• Strong understanding of audio implementation, performance optimization, and platform/technical constraints.

• Experience working in cross-functional environments with Product, Design, and Development departments.

• Experience in capacity planning, resource allocation, and scaling teams.

• Strong decision-making and prioritization skills across multiple concurrent projects.

• Ability to identify risks and proactively drive solutions.

• Strong cross-functional communication skills with both creative and technical stakeholders.

• Attention to detail in timing, layering, and mix balance, with the ability to evaluate and give feedback on others' work.

• Professional proficiency in English.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to define standards and iterate based on feedback.

WE OFFER

• Work alongside experienced international teams across Product, Tech, and Studio Operations.

• A fast-moving, growth-oriented environment where ideas quickly turn into real products.

• Competitive compensation that reflects your experience and the value you bring.

• Fully covered premium health insurance.

• Extra paid days off to celebrate your special occasions.

• Birthday gifts and team celebrations, because milestones should be recognized.

• Regular team-building events and company offsites.

• A modern, fully equipped office in central Tbilisi designed for both focus and collaboration.

We’re seeking a Product Management Analyst with deep, hands-on experience in data analytics, data governance, and data engineering, who can drive value from enterprise data platforms through disciplined Product Ownership and Agile delivery. You’ll own the backlog, translate complex data needs into actionable user stories, partner closely with engineering, and use SQL to validate data, troubleshoot issues, and inform decisions. Experience with Collibra and data quality frameworks is a strong plus.

*This is a remote position, but a preference for candidates in the DMV area*

Product Ownership & Strategy

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for data products (datasets, pipelines, quality rules, and dashboards), ensuring alignment to business outcomes and compliance needs

  • Convert stakeholders’ requirements into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria; maintain a transparent, prioritized backlog.

  • Define measurable product metrics (adoption, data quality scores, SLA compliance, performance) and track value realization.

Agile Delivery (Scrum)

  • Run Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Partner with Scrum Master and Technical Leads to remove impediments, manage scope, and keep delivery predictable.
  • Champion Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, ensuring data products meet quality, governance, and performance standards.

Data Analysis & SQL

  • Write and review SQL to validate datasets across environments;
  • Collaborate with analysts and data scientists to define KPIs, analytical features, and insight-driven use cases.

Data Governance & Collibra

  • Partner with Governance to establish stewardship workflows, standards, naming conventions, certification processes, and data issue resolution.
  • Use Data Catalog (Collibra or similar) to manage metadata, lineage, and data quality rules/scorecards; drive onboarding of governed datasets and monitor quality thresholds

Data Engineering Partnership

  • Work side-by-side with data engineers on ingestion, transformation, and orchestration patterns; ensure scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Provide clear requirements for schema design, partitioning, indexing, and performance optimization; validate outcomes via SQL and acceptance tests

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Lead discovery workshops; synthesize diverse viewpoints into consensus on priorities and release plans.
  • Create crisp artifacts: data dictionaries, business rules, lineage diagrams, workflow maps, and release notes; present progress and insights to business and leadership

  • 3+ years as a Product Management delivering data-centric products (analytics, governance, engineering)
  • SQL proficiency

  • Excellent communication skills; ability to present to clients and collaborate across engineering, governance, and business teams

Desired Skills:

  • Experience with Collibra or another Data Catalog tool (metadata, lineage, stewardship, DQ rules and scorecards
  • Exposure to modern data stacks (e.g., AWS/Azure, data lake/warehouse, orchestration tools), and working with data engineers, architects, and analysts

What do our Commercial Pest Control Technicians do?

The primary purpose of this role is to perform our industry leading pest management services for commercial customers. You will be responsible for identifying and eliminating pests from commercial properties by conducting thorough inspections, determining the type of pest infestation, applying appropriate treatments like pesticides and traps, and providing preventative measures to prevent future infestations, all while adhering to safety regulations and communicating with clients about pest control solutions.

  • Build relationships with customers, schedule and confirm their appointments, help with sales to current customers, and expand our product to new customers

  • Ensure that all pest control equipment is properly maintained, stocked, and in good working condition

  • Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations regarding pest control products and safety protocols

  • Drive and safely operate a company provided service vehicle (we provide routine maintenance)

Essential Job Functions:

  • Able to work both inside and outside in your local climate in company-provided weather gear

Job Description:

Nursing is the diagnosis and treatment of human response to actual or potential health problems. This includes establishing an intentional therapeutic relationship between a registered nurse and a patient and family. As a leader and the integrator of care, the professional nurse has the responsibility, authority, and accountability for planning, coordinating and evaluating the patient’s care needs.

Works with patients that are undergoing or recovering from anesthesia or sedation monitoring closely for complications and ensuring the optimal safety and comfort of patients under anesthesia.

Principle Responsibilities

  • Comprehensive assessment of patient and family needs; identification of outcomes based on needs assessment; establishing the plan of care; supervising the progress; and modification of the plan of care as needed.
  • Maintains education and competencies to remain proficient to provide high quality patient care practice and skills.
  • Incorporates evidence-based nursing practice taking into consideration current statutes, rules and regulations when developing the plan of care.
  • Establishes, in the collaboration with the family and patient, realistic and measurable patient expected outcomes based on nursing diagnoses, patients present and potential capabilities, goals, available resources and plan for continuity of care.
  • Identifies outcomes that are age appropriate, culturally appropriate, realistic and attainable.
  • Coordinates, collaborates, and delegates appropriately to ensure care is provided in a safe, effective fashion.
  • Fulfills all organizational requirements.
  • Supplemental roles:

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Associate's or Vocational degree
  • 0 to 2 years critical care RN experience


Preferred Qualifications

  • 0 to 2 years perianesthesia experience


Licenses/Certifications

  • Licensed Registered Nurse – MN Board of Nursing required if working in state of MN upon hire / WI Department of Safety & Professional Services required if working in the state of WI upon hire
  • Must meet at least ONE of the requirements below:
    ◦ Current ACLS certification from the American Heart Association
    ◦ Current ALS certification from the American Red Cross
    ◦ Allina in-house ACLS training (within 60 days of hire)
  • Additional certifications may be needed at certain sites:
    ◦ Pediatric Advance Life Support (PALS) is required within 180 days of hire
  • CPAN American Board of Perianesthesia Nursing Certification preferred
  • CAPA American Board of Perianesthesia Nursing Certification preferred

  • Analyze workflows, provider engagement, and operational barriers to identify opportunities for improvement.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Product, Analytics, Technology, Clinical Operations, Network, and Market leadership to coordinate successful implementation of enterprise Cost of Care solutions.
  • Influence stakeholders across a highly matrixed organization to remove barriers, build alignment, and accelerate execution.
  • Represent operational and market perspectives during enterprise solution design to ensure initiatives are practical, scalable, and sustainable.
  • Facilitate collaboration between enterprise and market teams to drive consistent execution and continuous improvement.

Executive Partnership

  • Provide regular updates regarding deployment progress, implementation effectiveness, adoption trends, operational risks, and optimization opportunities.
  • Develop executive-ready recommendations supported by operational insights, market feedback, and performance analysis.
  • Recommend deployment strategies, implementation priorities, and operational improvements that support enterprise Cost of Care objectives.

  • Foster collaborative relationships across enterprise and market teams.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, accountability, professionalism, and attention to detail.
  • Understand, adhere to, and implement Company policies and procedures.

Minimum Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations, physician practice operations, population health, care management, value-based care, clinical operations, or related healthcare environments.
  • Demonstrated success implementing and operationalizing complex initiatives across multiple sites, markets, or business units.
  • Experience partnering directly with physicians, practice leadership, and operational leaders to improve clinical or operational performance.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives within highly matrixed organizations.
  • Experience driving organizational change, operational improvement, and stakeholder engagement across multiple levels of an organization.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting physician organizations participating in value-based care or risk-based payment models.
  • Experience developing and scaling operational programs across geographically dispersed markets.
  • Experience leading implementation, optimization, or transformation initiatives in physician-centric healthcare organizations.

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate data into operational action.
  • Experience developing scalable operating models, implementation frameworks, and operational playbooks.

Minimum Qualifications

title: Community Response Coordinator
description:
This position is located on the Cornell University Campus in Ithaca, New York.

No Visa sponsorship available for this position.

Who we are:

Located in Ithaca, N.Y., Cornell University is a bold, innovative, inclusive, and dynamic teaching and research university where staff, faculty, and students alike are challenged to make an enduring contribution to the betterment of humanity. Cornell University is one of the largest and most diverse institutions in the Ivy League. We are a community of 22,000 students and more than 10,000 faculty and staff members representing more than 80 countries and hundreds of disciplines—global cultures, backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and ideas.

The Division of Public Safety (DPS) is a group of public safety units that work collaboratively with our community to keep Cornell a safe and secure campus to learn and live. It is comprised of the Public Safety 911 Communications Center, the Cornell University Police Department, the Office of Emergency Management, the Clery Compliance Office, the Access Control Program, the Community Response Team, and the Public Safety Ambassadors.

The Community Response Team is a unit within the Division of Public Safety. This team works in concert with other emergency response resources such as Cornell Emergency Management Services, Cornell Environment Health & Safety, Cornell EMS, Cornell Public Safety Communications Center, and the Cornell University Police. The team is housed with other first response resources in the Division of Public Safety.

*This position may require evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

What you will do:
You will be a part of a team of Community Response Coordinators and clinicians who provide first responder behavioral health services and facilitate resource connection in partnership with individuals in crisis on Cornell’s Ithaca campus. This position will respond to calls for service, conduct risk and safety assessments, make appropriate referrals and handoffs to appropriate wraparound university, city, and county services.

The Community Response Team plays a key role across Cornell’s health and safety crisis response infrastructure of prioritizing the diversion of individuals in emotional distress or crisis from unnecessary hospital transportation and facilitating their connection to supportive resources. Community Response Coordinators aim to serve a broad range of individuals in crisis situations and collaborate within the campus' larger system of care to address the needs of community members, creating an intermediary level between current structures that appropriately balance the response with the need.

While position responsibilities vary, every member of our community is expected to foster a culture of belonging and a healthy work environment by communicating across differences; being cooperative, collaborative, open, and welcoming; showing respect, compassion, and empathy; engaging and supporting others regardless of background or perspective; speaking up when others are being excluded or treated inappropriately; and supporting work/life integration of oneself and others.

Who you are:
You are a positive, customer service orientated person who takes pride in providing prompt, courteous service to all. You possess exceptional interpersonal skills, empathy and openness to new ideas and perspectives on a wide range of topics. Additionally, you exercise sound judgement and decision making with urgent and sensitive information. You have strong communication skills and build effective working relationships with a broad range of individuals and organizations. You will have knowledge of collaborative techniques and coordinated community response models.

Some other important qualifications for the position include:

  • Bachelor’s degree (in social work, psychology, or another field related to human services and health); and 2 to 4 years relevant experience (in social services, mental health care, domestic violence or sexual assault support, or similar health field) or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Must handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Must possess strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to work an evening schedule and weekends, and holidays (when business needs require).
  • Exemplify high ethical standards, reasoning skills, and judgment in all aspects of the work responsibilities.
  • Must possess and maintain a valid NYS Driver’s License. Out-of-state employees must obtain and show proof of a NYS license within 30 days of starting employment.
  • Experience working with inclusion, belonging, and wellbeing programs.
  • Experience working directly with people from various socioeconomic backgrounds.
  • Ability to serve as an advocate for individuals from a broad range of backgrounds.
  • Ability to cultivate and develop inclusive and equitable working relationships with students, faculty, staff, and community members.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Although the role is non-clinical, clinical training is valued for its relevance to trauma-informed care, behavioral assessments, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
  • Possession of any of the following licenses or certifications: Licensed Master of Social Work (LMSW), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC), Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), Credentialed Alcoholism and Substance Abuse Counselor (CASAC)
  • Master’s degree in social work/mental health, student affairs/development, health & human services, or similar field.
  • Experience with:
    • Higher education and/or with youth in crisis, mental health and/or wellness, Sexual assault survivors/victims, Human services case management, Emergency medical services, and/or law enforcement agencies.
  • Bilingual and/or Multilingual.

Candidates are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet every preferred qualification.

Experience gained prior to licensure - paid and volunteer - will also be considered when assessing qualifications.

What we offer:

Great benefits including generous retirement contributions, educational benefits, comprehensive health care options, access to a plethora of wellness programs, and employee discounts with local and national retail brands. Our leave provisions include three weeks of vacation, two floating holidays and 13 holidays: Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and the day after, and an end of the year winter break from December 25-January 1. We invite you to follow this link to learn more about the Total Rewards of Working at Cornell:

Cornell is situated in picturesque Ithaca, New York, the heart of the Finger Lakes. Ithaca is home to two academic institutions, state parks, waterfalls, gorges, and a wide range of art galleries, theaters, eateries, wineries, and breweries. Ithaca is an active and diverse community to work and thrive in and has something to suit all ages and interests!

You’ll contribute to software systems where reliability, performance, and precision are essential. This is an opportunity to work on mission-critical infrastructure supporting national airspace operations — collaborating with experienced engineers to modernize complex, real-world systems.

description:

This position will be responsible for the delivery of established Family Development programming in support of Soldier and Family Readiness Division programs and will deliver other established Family Development programming and activities, both on-site and off-site in accordance with the Fort Drum Program Area’s plan of work. This position will also coordinate all administrative aspects of the Family Development Program and will assist the Fort Drum Issue Leader with marketing efforts for Family Development programming.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR APPLICANTS:

PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

All applicants must apply online by close of day on September 15, 2026 to be considered for this position. All applicants must submit an application online, which includes: cover letter, resume and three (3) references.

All External Applicants (including applicants currently employed by Cornell Cooperative Extension in Associations other than the Association advertising this career opportunity) must submit his/her application materials via the "APPLY" button located within this job posting.

All Internal Applicants (current employees working for the Association advertising this career opportunity) must apply online via his/her Workday account, which may be accessed here: .

Please contact Erin O'Rourke Parnapy, Assistant Manager for Human Resources and Operations at 315-788-8450 with questions.

POSITION DETAILS:

This position is a full-time non-exempt position - 100% FTE, 40 hours per week. The hourly rate for this position is $22.50. This position, based on eligibility, offers a comprehensive benefit package, to include: health and dental insurance, NYS retirement, vacation, sick and personal leave.

POSITION INFORMATION:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in social work, psychology, marriage and family, child counseling, behavioral science, education, community health, public health or equivalent education (Associate’s Degree and two (2) years transferable program/functional experience.

  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in family and children’s services or community organizations.
  • Minimum of one (1) year experience in domestic/family violence education/prevention.
  • Valid New York State Driver’s License and the ability to meet travel requirements associated with this position.
  • Ability to work flexible hours which may include evenings and/or weekends, as appropriate.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with parenting education, family and child development, and military family life.
  • Familiarity with issues revolving around poverty, families at risk, and domestic violence.
  • Familiarity with community, social and human service organizations, employment services and resources.
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize program resources within the Fort Drum community and general community.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan, teach and evaluate informal educational programs through a variety of delivery methods to reach individuals and groups.
  • Demonstrated ability to function as a team member working with volunteers and staff.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize reference materials for programming purposes.
  • Demonstrated ability to relate to diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively through oral, written and visual means.
  • Demonstrated ability to utilize computer technologies for educational and communication purposes.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

Program Responsibilities:

Program Delivery, Evaluation and Applied Research - 80%

  • Utilize established program resources and materials in program work.
  • Implement existing Family Development programming the Soldier and Family Development Division, to include, but not limited to: Stress & Anger Management, Parenting After Separation & Divorce, Positive Parenting, Building Blocks for Better Communication, Creating a Kid Friendly Healthy and Safe Living Environment, etc.
  • Implement already-established Family Development educational programing and activities in support of other Fort Drum programming efforts as identified/needed to support the established plan of work.
  • Per already established program parameters and utilizing existing resources, assist in providing educational programing of child abuse and neglect, and domestic violence prevention (i.e. Community and Troop Education Program, Parenting Skills Education Program, Preventive Education Program through Stress Management and Anger Control, etc.).
  • Under the direction and oversight of the Fort Drum Issue Leader, occasionally apply established subject matter knowledge to create lesson plans as identified.
  • Provide Family Development educational programs via mass media.
  • Work to foster acceptance of the Family Development Program, methods and policies while addressing community and individual needs and considering diverse audiences.
  • Serve as a team member and cooperate with the entire Association and Fort Drum Program staff to achieve Association program delivery goals.
  • Implement program evaluation as designed.
  • Interact with program participants to obtain evaluation data, to include: evaluating effectiveness of classes and instructors within program areas for all Family Development Programs offered through the Family and Soldier Readiness Division.
  • Assist Fort Drum Issue Leader in the process of analyzing program data, and based on that analysis, assist in making recommendations for improvements in program offerings.
  • Communicate evaluation findings to constituents as appropriate.

Administrative Responsibilities:

Direction and Management - 10%

  • Assist in the planning and promotion of major public events and programs (i.e. Stress & Anger Management, Positive Parenting, Building Blocks for Better Communication,, Creating a Kid Friendly Healthy and Safe Living Environment, Play Groups, Baby Bundles, Command and Troop Education, etc.), including, but not limited to: assisting with mass media efforts related to upcoming events and programs.
  • Under the direction of the Fort Drum Issue Leader, provide program guidance to program volunteers in accordance with established practices and procedures.
  • Assist in identifying and recommending program needs (i.e. program supplies and materials) to the Fort Drum Issue Leader.
  • Assist in providing existing guidance to program volunteers in accordance with established practices and procedures.

Coordination/Operation - 5%

  • Organize and coordinate activities related to Family Development Programming (i.e. Play Group, Baby Bundles, Baby Palooza, etc.).
  • Coordinate identified administrative aspects of the Family Development Program to include, but not limited to: preparing correspondence, maintain files, etc.
  • Coordinate, compile and organize existing program resources and program materials.
  • Effectively maintain existing professional relationships with other agencies, organizations and businesses that promote effective communication and facilitate continued programming efforts.
  • Assist in utilizing effective marketing strategies in the promotion of programming efforts to include, but not limited to: print media, news media, social media, and multi-media efforts.
  • This position may require the transport of program participants and/or program materials and resources in performing position responsibilities.

Professional Improvement and Other Duties as Assigned - 5%

  • In cooperation with Supervisor and/or Executive Director, jointly develop and pursue a professional development plan as a means to increase competencies relative to position accountabilities and to address changes in programming and association priorities.
  • Collaborate in activities that are in general support of Cornell Cooperative Extension including but not limited to attendance at staff meetings, timely reporting of expenses, working with other staff, general marketing of Extension programs and other duties as assigned.

Health and Safety - Applied to all duties and functions.

  • Support the association to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Be familiar and strive to follow any applicable federal, state, local regulations, association health and safety policy/procedure/requirement and standard.
  • Act proactively to prevent accidents/injuries and communicate hazards to supervisors when identified.

Description du poste

En raison d’une croissance soutenue, Altus est à la recherche d’un(e) Conseiller(ère) en coûts de construction possédant une expertise en pré-construction et en construction. Il s’agit d’une excellente occasion de rejoindre une équipe dynamique et en expansion, tout en contribuant à des projets de construction complexes et d’envergure dans divers secteurs, notamment les développements à usage mixte, les immeubles commerciaux et de bureaux, les établissements institutionnels, les projets gouvernementaux et d’infrastructure, ainsi que les projets résidentiels. En collaboration avec des professionnels chevronnés, vous participerez à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie des projets et contribuerez à la réalisation d’initiatives qui façonnent les collectivités et l’environnement bâti.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la préparation d’estimations de coûts précises, de relevés quantitatifs, de plans de coûts, de budgets et de documents d’appel d’offres pour des projets de construction. Vous appuierez la planification des projets, l’approvisionnement, le contrôle des coûts, l’administration des contrats et la production de rapports financiers afin d’assurer le respect des budgets approuvés et l’atteinte des objectifs des clients.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les clients, les gestionnaires de projet, les architectes, les ingénieurs, les propriétaires, les entrepreneurs et les autres parties prenantes, en fournissant des conseils stratégiques en gestion des coûts et en matière commerciale afin de soutenir une prise de décision éclairée et la réussite des projets.

Responsabilités principales:

  • Préparer des relevés quantitatifs détaillés à partir des plans, devis et autres documents de projet.

  • Élaborer des estimations de coûts conceptuelles, de pré-construction et détaillées.

  • Analyser les plans et devis afin d’évaluer les coûts de main-d’œuvre, de matériaux, d’équipement et de sous-traitance.

  • Solliciter, examiner et évaluer les soumissions des sous-traitants et fournisseurs.

  • Identifier les risques et les opportunités ayant une incidence sur les coûts des projets.

  • Assurer le suivi des budgets et des coûts tout au long du cycle de vie des projets.

  • Préparer des plans de coûts, des prévisions de flux monétaires, des échéanciers de projet et des rapports budgétaires.

  • Évaluer les ordres de changement et les variations contractuelles.

  • Participer aux Analyses de la valeur afin d’optimiser les coûts des projets.

  • Examiner et valider les demandes de paiement des entrepreneurs et sous-traitants.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de projets, ingénieurs, architectes et clients.

  • Participer aux réunions de projet et fournir un soutien sur les enjeux commerciaux et contractuels.

  • Préparer des rapports de coûts de projet et des sommaires exécutifs.

  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes et externes pour préparer, rédiger et émettre les rapports requis.

  • Veiller au respect des procédures de l’entreprise, des exigences contractuelles et des normes de l’industrie.

Qualifications principales:

  • Baccalauréat, diplôme universitaire ou diplôme technique en économie de la construction, gestion de la construction, architecture, génie civil, sciences du bâtiment ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • Titre professionnel ou démarche active vers une accréditation telle que ÉCA, ECCQ ou RICS.

  • Expérience pertinente en estimation de construction et en gestion des coûts.

  • Excellente connaissance des normes de l’Institut canadien des économistes en construction (ICÉC) relatives au format des estimations, aux méthodes de relevé des quantités (par éléments et par corps de métier) et à l’établissement des coûts, ainsi que des conditions contractuelles normalisées du CCDC.

  • Bonne connaissance des méthodes de construction, des matériaux et des pratiques de l’industrie.

  • Solides compétences en relevés quantitatifs et en estimation.

  • Bonne compréhension des contrats de construction et des processus d’approvisionnement.

  • Excellentes aptitudes analytiques et numériques.

  • Capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets et à respecter des échéanciers serrés.

  • Souci marqué du détail et de l’exactitude.

  • Maîtrise de logiciel d’estimation (Tel que CostX, Bluebeam, On-Screen Takeoff, PlanSwift, ou autre).

  • Connaissance avancée de la suite Microsoft Office, notamment Excel et Word

  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale en français et en anglais.

Job Summary:

As a result of accelerated growth, Altus is looking for a new Quantity Surveyor with pre-construction and construction stage expertise. This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team and work on high-profile, complex construction projects across a diverse range of sectors, including mixed-use developments, commercial and office buildings, institutional facilities, government projects and infrastructure, as well as residential developments. Working alongside experienced professionals, you will be involved throughout all phases of the project lifecycle, contributing to the successful delivery of projects that shape communities and the built environment.

In this role, you will be responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates, quantity take-offs, cost plans, budgets, and tender submissions for construction projects. You will support project planning, procurement, cost control, contract administration, and financial reporting to help ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets and meet client objectives. You will collaborate closely with clients, project managers, architects, engineers, owners, contractors, and other project stakeholders, providing cost and commercial advice to support informed decision-making and the successful achievement of project goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare detailed quantity take-offs from drawings, specifications, and other project documents.

  • Develop conceptual, pre-construction, and detailed cost estimates.

  • Analyze project plans and specifications to determine labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor costs.

  • Solicit, review, and evaluate subcontractor and supplier quotations.

  • Identify project risks and opportunities affecting project costs.

  • Monitor project budgets and track costs throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Prepare cost plans, cash flow forecasts, project schedules and budget reports.

  • Evaluate change orders and variations.

  • Assist in value engineering exercises to optimize project costs.

  • Review and validate contractor and subcontractor payment applications.

  • Collaborate with project managers, engineers, architects, and clients.

  • Attend project meetings and provide commercial input.

  • Prepare project cost reports and executive summaries.

  • Collaborate with internal/external partners to prepare, write and issue reports

  • Ensure compliance with company procedures and industry standards.

Key Qualifications:

  • Bachelor or technology degree or diploma in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Architecture, Civil Engineering, building science or a related field.

  • Professional accreditation or working towards membership such as PQS, ECCQ, RICS.

  • Experience in construction estimating, quantity surveying, or cost management.

  • Strong knowledge of CIQS standard method of measurement, both elemental and trade, provincial lien acts, and CCDC standard contract conditions

  • Knowledge of construction methods, materials, and industry practices.

  • Strong quantity take-off and estimating skills.

  • Understanding of construction contracts and procurement processes.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

  • Attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Proficiency with an estimating software (such as CostX, Bluebeam, On-Screen Takeoff, Planswift, etc.).

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, etc.).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and French.

title: Regionchef
description:
Life at ForMotion – Feel Good, Grow, Be Inspired

Vill du hjälpa människor till ett rörligare liv? Vi söker en erfaren Regionchef till Stockholm som vill vara med och utveckla våra verksamheter samt framtidens ortopedteknik. I Stockholm har vi fem ortopedtekniska kliniker med totalt cirka 120 medarbetare. Våra kliniker är starkt efterfrågade samarbetspartner inom många diagnosområden, och vi har goda relationer med andra yrkesprofessioner och möjligheterna är stora att utveckla dessa relationer ytterligare.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som Regionchef ansvarar du för att leda, utveckla och säkerställa resultat i region Stockholm i linje med ForMotions strategi, mål och värderingar. Rollen innebär ett helhetsansvar för verksamheten i regionen, inklusive ekonomi, drift, personalansvar och kvalitet, med fokus på att skapa stabilitet, tydlighet och genomförandekraft i en komplex och konkurrensutsatt marknad. Du är en nyckelperson i att omsätta strategisk riktning till konkret verksamhetsresultat och i att skapa förutsättningar för klinikerna att lyckas i vardagen. Du ingår i bolagets ledningsstruktur, är del i ledningsgrupp och du rapporterar till Managing Director (VD) Sverige. I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår bland annat:

  • Säkerställa effektiv drift på samtliga kliniker och enheter inom regionen
  • Vara en närvarande och coachande ledare för regionens chefer
  • Identifiera utvecklingsmöjligheter inom patientflöden, erbjudande och affär
  • Säkerställa att beslut och initiativ från ledningen implementeras i regionen
  • Övergripande ansvar för bemanning, kompetens och organisationsstruktur i regionen
  • Driva förbättringsarbete kopplat till effektivitet, kvalitet och patientnytta
  • Ansvarar för att representera regionens behov i bolagsövergripande forum

Vi står inför en viktig utvecklingsresa där vi vill lägga grunden för att skapa kliniker i absolut framkant. Vår ambition är att ytterligare höja kvaliteten i allt vi gör och samtidigt stärka vår position som en attraktiv arbetsgivare. Som Regionchef får du en central roll i att driva detta arbete framåt och bidra till en verksamhet där både patienter och medarbetare får de bästa förutsättningarna att utvecklas.

Vem vi söker

Du är en engagerad och kommunikativ ledare med mycket god förmåga att kombinera strategisk inriktning med operativt genomförande. Du har ett tydligt och coachande ledarskap med hög affärsförståelse i en marknad präglad av upphandling och kostnadspress. Du har dessutom mycket god förmåga att skapa struktur utan att tappa tempo, samarbeta och bygga goda relationer samt driva förbättrings- och förändringsarbete.

  • Flerårig erfarenhet av ledarskap i en större kontext inklusive personalansvar, budgetering, arbetsmiljö, affärsutveckling och verksamhetsutveckling
  • God erfarenhet inom privatvården
  • Flytande språkkunskaper i svenska och mycket goda kunskaper i engelska
  • Mycket god dator- och systemvana
  • Det är meriterande ifall du har erfarenhet inom ortopedtekniska branschen
  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område är meriterande

Vi erbjuder

Du kommer att arbeta i en global, innovativ och värderingsstyrd verksamhet som kännetecknas av högt engagemang och fokus på att hjälpa människor genom att ge bästa möjliga service. På ForMotion använder vi oss till stor del av digitala arbetssätt i vårt kliniska arbete och vi erbjuder kompetensutveckling och internutbildning för chefer. Du kommer dessutom att ha ett omväxlande och meningsfullt arbete - i slutändan hjälper du människor till ett rörligare liv!

Anställningen

Heltid, tillsvidare. Vi tillämpar 6 månaders prövotid. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. ForMotion har kollektivavtal.

För mer information om tjänsten vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Manager Eva Niemi, eniemi@emblamedical.com

title: RN-Emergency Department
description:

Worker Type:

Job Summary:

Provides direct nursing care in settings where patients require complex assessments and intervention, in accordance with established policies, procedures and protocols of the healthcare organization.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements:

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collects comprehensive data pertinent to the health care consumer’s health and/or situation.
  • Triages each health care consumer utilizing age, developmentally appropriate, and culturally sensitive practices to prioritize and optimize health care consumer flow, expediting those health care consumers who require immediate care.
  • Analyzes the assessment data to determine the diagnosis or issues.
  • Identifies expected outcomes for a plan individualized to the health care consumer or the situation.
  • Implements, coordinates, and educates, to promote health and a safe practice environment.
  • Evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes.
  • Communicates effectively in a variety of formats in all areas of practice.
  • Demonstrates leadership in the professional practice setting and the profession.
  • Attains knowledge and competence that reflect current nursing practice.
  • Applies the existing body of evidence-based practice and scientific knowledge in health care to Emergency Nursing practice, ensuring that nursing care is delivered based on patient’s age-specific needs and clinical needs as described in the department's Scope of Service.
  • Works in a constant state of alertness and safe manner.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION

  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing or education equivalency for licensing

EXPERIENCE
